text: Dzɔdzɔmeŋutinunya siwo tso Standfort Yunivɛsiti suku si fia atikewɔwɔ ɖe gbefã lãme dodokpɔ dɔwɔnu yeyewo siwo ateŋu ɖe lãmenugbagbeviwo to ɖe ɖoɖo nu ƒe toto le Dzoɖagbe. Dɔwɔnu sue siwo woateŋu wɔ kple agbalẽtamɔ̃ siwo axɔ abe United States ga cent ɖeka ene
text_en: On Monday, scientists from the Stanford University School of Medicine announced the invention of a new diagnostic tool that can sort cells by type: a tiny printable chip that can be manufactured using standard inkjet printers for possibly about one U.S. cent each.

text: Nugɔmekula siwo do ŋgᴐ gblɔ be esia ateŋu aɖe kansa, yɔmekpe, HIV dɔlékuia kple asrãdɔ fia kaba le du siwo me fetu mede naneke o la me. Dukɔ siwo me amewo tsia agbe le dɔlélewo abe no me kansa ene la anɔ abe dukᴐ deŋgɔwo ƒe afã tᴐ ene.
text_en: Lead researchers say this may bring early detection of cancer, tuberculosis, HIV and malaria to patients in low-income countries, where the survival rates for illnesses such as breast cancer can be half those of richer countries.

text: JAS 39C Gripen ge eye wòwó ɖe yameʋudzeƒea ƒe mɔ dzi le ŋdi 9:30 lɔƒo (anɔ zã 02:30). Exe yameʋudzeƒea ƒe mɔ na asitsatsa yameʋuwo.
text_en: The JAS 39C Gripen crashed onto a runway at around 9:30 am local time (0230 UTC) and exploded, closing the airport to commercial flights.

text: Yameʋukula ƒe ŋkɔ nye Squadron Leader Dilokrit Pattavee
text_en: The pilot was identified as Squadron Leader Dilokrit Pattavee.

text: Nutoa me nyatakaka dɔwɔƒewo gblɔ be yameʋudzeƒea ƒe dzotsiʋu aɖe mli esime wonɔ yiyim
text_en: Local media reports an airport fire vehicle rolled over while responding.

text: Vidal si xɔ ƒe 28 va ge ɖe Barcelona afɔbɔlu ƒo ha me le bɔlu ƒo ɣeyiɣi etɔ megbe esime wodzo le Sevilla
text_en: 28-year-old Vidal had joined Barça three seasons ago, from Sevilla.

text: Tso ɣeyiɣi si woyi Catalantɔwo ƒe fiadua me la, Vidal ƒɔ bɔlu 49 na afɔbɔlu ƒo ha
text_en: Since moving to the Catalan-capital, Vidal had played 49 games for the club.

text: Tsitretsitsi zɔlia dze egɔme le ŋdi ga 11: 00 lɔƒo tso Whitehall, si le megbe na kpovitɔwo ƒe dɔwɔƒe, yiɖe Downing Street si le dudɔnunɔla gbãtɔ ƒe aƒe gbɔ
text_en: The protest started around 11:00 local time (UTC+1) on Whitehall opposite the police-guarded entrance to Downing Street, the Prime Minister's official residence.

text: Le ga 11:00 megbe la, tsitretsitsi azɔ̃lizɔ̃lawo he mɔ na mɔzɔlawo le Whitehall dzigbe gome.
text_en: Just after 11:00, protesters blocked traffic on the northbound carriage in Whitehall.

text: Le 11:20 la, kpovitɔwo bia tso tsitretsitsi zɔ̃lizɔ̃lawo gbɔ be woadzo le mɔa di.Le woƒe nya gbɔgblɔ nu la, azɔ̃lizɔlawo kpɔ mɔnu azɔ̃ le gake woma he mɔ na mɔzɔlawo o.
text_en: At 11:20, the police asked the protesters to move back on to the pavement, stating that they needed to balance the right to protest with the traffic building up.

text: Le ga 11:29 lɔƒo la, zɔ̃lizɔzɔa yiɖe edzi le Whitehall tso Trafalgar Square yiɖe Stand si le Aldwych kple Kingsway yina Holborn, afi si Conservative Party me nɔlawo nɔa woƒe adame takpekpe wɔm le, le Grand Connaught amedzrodzeƒe ƒe xɔwo me
text_en: Around 11:29, the protest moved up Whitehall, past Trafalgar Square, along the Strand, passing by Aldwych and up Kingsway towards Holborn where the Conservative Party were holding their Spring Forum in the Grand Connaught Rooms hotel.

text: Le gododoa me la, Nadal do age 7, ke Kanadatɔ yea la do age 2
text_en: Nadal's head to head record against the Canadian is 7–2.

text: Esi me Brisbane ƒe gododoa dze egɔme la, Roanic ɖu Nadal dzi.
text_en: He recently lost against Raonic in the Brisbane Open.

text: Nadal ƒe age si wòdo le gododo gbãtɔa me la wɔe be exɔ "88 ɖe alafa dzi." Esia wɔe be wòxɔ dzesi 76.
text_en: Nadal bagged 88% net points in the match winning 76 points in the first serve.

text: Le kametetea megbe la, Clay ƒe kametela gã gblɔ be: "mekpɔ dzidzɔ ŋutɔ bena meteŋu va ɖo kametete vevie sia ƒe akpa mamle tɔ." Mawɔ nye nutete bena kplua nasu asi nye.
text_en: After the match, King of Clay said, "I am just excited about being back in the final rounds of the most important events. I am here to try to win this."

text: Le dame, ƒe 2016 lia me la, nyadzɔdzɔ gbalẽwo ƒonu kuɖe agbalẽ fitifiti aɖewo siwo ƒe xexlẽme anɔ abe miliɔ̃ ewo ene la ŋu. Woyɔ agbalẽ siawo be "Panama ƒe agbalẽwo" eye wotso Panama ƒe setaʋliwo gbɔ.
text_en: "Panama Papers" is an umbrella term for roughly ten million documents from Panamanian law firm Mossack Fonseca, leaked to the press in spring 2016.

text: Agbalẽ siawo ɖe fia be gadzraɖoƒe wuiene wɔ adzame kpekpeɖeŋu na hotui tɔwo kple susu be woateŋu ɖo asi dɔla akpe akpewo dzi eye bena woaƒo asa na adzᴐgaxexe kple ɖoɖo bubuwo.
text_en: The documents showed fourteen banks helped wealthy clients hide billions of US dollars of wealth to avoid taxes and other regulations.

text: British nyadzɔdzɔ gbalẽ "The Guardian" gblɔ be Dzamani gadzraɖoƒea ƒe asi le dɔwɔƒe 1200 siwo wɔna nu fitifiti siawo me.
text_en: British newspaper The Guardian suggested Deutsche Bank controlled roughly a third of the 1200 shell companies used to accomplish this.

text: Ame geɖewo tsi tre eye woɖo asi zãnuɖula geɖewo dzi hena ʋɔnudɔdrɔ. Evɔ Pakistant kple Island ƒe dukplɔlawo yea ɖe asi le zikpuia ŋu.
text_en: There were protests worldwide, several criminal prosecutions, and the leaders of the governments of Iceland and Pakistan both resigned.

text: Wodzi Ma le Hong Kong gake ede sukukɔkɔ le New York kple senyalawo ƒe sukukɔkɔ le Hadvard. Amerikatɔwo ƒe amedzrovi gbalẽ si woyɔna be "gbemumu gbalẽvi" la nɔ esi.
text_en: Born in Hong Kong, Ma studied at New York University and Harvard Law School and once held an American permanent resident "green card".

text: Le akɔdada ƒe ɣeyiɣiawo me la, Aƒetɔ Hsieh gblɔ be, nenye be dukɔa va le ɣeyiɣisesẽwo me tom la, Ma ateŋu asi adzo fãa.
text_en: Hsieh implied during the election that Ma might flee the country during a time of crisis.

text: Aƒetɔ Hsieh ga gblɔ hã be wodo atsã na Ma ƒe akɔdagbãlevia ƒe nɔnɔmetata tsɔ wu ale si wodze be wòanɔ.
text_en: Hsieh also argued that the photogenic Ma was more style than substance.

text: Togbɔ be wotsɔ nya geɖe siawo le eŋu hã la, Ma kpɔ dziɖuɖu to ɖoɖo siwo wowɔ daɖi kple "Tshaina" ƒe dukɔa.
text_en: Despite these accusations, Ma won handily on a platform advocating closer ties with the Chinese mainland.

text: Egbe ƒe bɔlƒola nyuie enye Alex Overchkin si tso Washington fiadu la me
text_en: Today's Player of the Day is Alex Ovechkin of the Washington Capitals.

text: Edo age 2 eye wòwɔ kpekpeɖeŋu zi 2 le Washington ƒe bɔlu si woƒo kple Atlanta Thrashers bɔlƒoha esime woɖu dzi kple age 5 - 3
text_en: He had 2 goals and 2 assists in Washington's 5-3 win over the Atlanta Thrashers.

text: Overchkin ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu gbãtɔ vae eme le eƒe dziɖuɖu ge si wodo le zã bɔlu si woƒo kple rookie Nicklas Backstrom me.
text_en: Ovechkin's first assist of the night was on the game-winning goal by rookie Nicklas Backstrom;

text: Eƒe age evelia si wodo zã me la nye eƒe age 60 lia le hoʋiʋlia me. Enye bɔlƒola gbãtɔ si do age 60 alo edzivɔwo le hoʋiʋli wɔna me tso keke ƒe 1995 kple 96 esime Jaromir Jagr kple Mario Lemineux wo hã do age xexleme ma ke
text_en: his second goal of the night was his 60th of the season, becoming the first player to score 60 or more goals in a season since 1995-96, when Jaromir Jagr and Mario Lemieux each reached that milestone.

text: Batten nye ame 190 lia le ƒe 2008 Amerika kesinɔtɔwo kekeake 400 dome kple ga home asu dɔlar biliɔn 2.3
text_en: Batten was ranked 190th on the 2008 400 Richest Americans list with an estimated fortune of $2.3 billion.

text: Ewu suku kɔkɔ nu le Virginia Yunivɛsiti nutata kple dzɔdzɔmeŋutinunya kɔledzi le ƒe 1950 eye wònye dɔkta xɔ ŋkɔ le teƒe ma ke
text_en: He graduated from the College of Arts & Sciences of the University of Virginia in 1950 and was a significant donor to that institution.

text: Wotɔ dzo Irak ƒe gaxɔ si le Abu Ghraib le ŋunyaŋunya gã la me.
text_en: Iraq's Abu Ghraib prison has been set alight during a riot.

text: Enye gaxɔ aɖe si xɔ ŋkɔ; ɖe gamenɔlawo ƒe nu manyomanyo wɔwɔ ta le esime wonɔ Amerika ƒe ŋusẽ ƒe atsekpakpa te.
text_en: The jail became notorious after prisoner abuse was discovered there after US forces took over.

text: Le ʋu kuku kametete si va eme le "Sĩgapu" le ƒe 2008 lia me la, Piquet Jr ƒe ʋu si kum wòle la ƒe ataya wo. Esia wɔe be ʋu si kpɔna dedienɔnɔnyawo gbɔ le kametete sia me la do.
text_en: Piquet Jr. crashed in the 2008 Singapore Grand Prix just after an early pit stop for Fernando Alonso, bringing out the safety car.

text: Le esi me ʋu siwo le "Alɔ̃zo" ƒe ŋkɔ, yi be ye woa xɔ ami la, Piquet gbɔ to woŋu eye wonye ame gbãtɔ.
text_en: As the cars ahead of Alonso went in for fuel under the safety car, he moved up the pack to take victory.

text: Wo he to na Piquet Jr. le ƒe 2009 lia ƒe kametete si va eme le Hungarian megbe.
text_en: Piquet Jr. was sacked after the 2009 Hungarian Grand Prix.

text: Le ŋdi ga 8:46 pɛpɛpɛ la, ɖoɖoe gã aɖe zi le dua katã me si ɖo ŋku ɣeyiɣi tututu yameʋu gbãtɔ gbã eƒe taɖodzinu
text_en: At exactly 8:46 a.m. a hush fell across the city, marking the exact moment the first jet struck its target.

text: Wode dzo keklẽ sue eve ɖe dzi ne woaklẽ le zame
text_en: Two beams of light have been rigged up to point skywards overnight.

text: Xɔ kɔkɔ atɔ tutuwo le edzi yim le teƒea siwo me mɔzɔzɔ dɔwɔƒe kple ŋkuɖodzi teƒe le titina anɔ
text_en: Construction is ongoing for five new skyscrapers at the site, with a transportation center and memorial park in the middle.

text: PBS nukpɔkpɔa xɔ Emmy nunana wu zi eve, eye eƒe didime le kpuie wu Sesame Street kple Rogers' Neighborhood.
text_en: The PBS show has more than two-dozen Emmy awards, and its run is shorter only than Sesame Street and Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.

text: Nukpɔkpɔa ƒe nuwɔwɔ ɖe sia ɖe aku ɖe nyati aɖe ŋu le agbalẽ aɖe me eye wòaka gbe le nyatia ŋu to ŋutinya geɖewo me.
text_en: Each episode of the show would focus on a theme in a specific book and then explore that theme through multiple stories.

text: Nukpɔkpɔ ɖe sia ɖe hã aƒo nu nyuie atso agbalẽ siwo wole be ɖeviwo nadi ne woyi woƒe agbalẽxlẽƒewo
text_en: Each show would also provide recommendations for books that children should look for when they went to their library.

text: John Grant, si tso WNED Buffalo (Reading Raining’s home station) gblɔ be “Reading Rainbow fia ɖeviwo susu si ta woaxlẽ nu, lɔlɔ̃tsɔtsɔ na nuxexlẽ- [nukpɔkpɔa] dea dzi ƒo na wo be woatsɔ agbalẽ axlẽ.”
text_en: John Grant, from WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow's home station) said "Reading Rainbow taught kids why to read,... the love of reading — [the show] encouraged kids to pick up a book and to read."

text: Ame aɖewo abe John Grant xɔe se be nu eve siwo nye ga ƒe vɔvɔ kple heheɖa tso nufiafiame si kuɖe wɔna siwo naa hehe ame ƒe anyinɔnɔ le television dzi na be ɖoɖoa nu tsi.
text_en: It is believed by some, including John Grant, that both the funding crunch and a shift in the philosophy of educational television programming contributed to ending the series.

text: Ya sesẽ si ƒo anɔ abe agbadzroƒe 645 ene (kilometa 1040) didi tso Cape Verde ƒe ƒukpowo gbɔ la, gbagba eye wògble nu le teƒe geɖe
text_en: The storm, situated about 645 miles (1040 km) west of the Cape Verde islands, is likely to dissipate before threatening any land areas, forecasters say.

text: Ya sesẽ si woyɔna be Fred la ƒo eye eƒe dzuƒuƒu anɔ abe kilometa 165 le gaƒoƒo ɖeka me ene yi na ɖe dziehe kpadzi.
text_en: Fred currently has winds of 105 miles per hour (165 km/h) and is moving towards the northwest.

text: Tso keke esi me wodze yamenutomemɔ̃wo zazã gɔme la, Fred enye aƒugome ɣedzeƒe ƒe ya sesẽ gbãtɔ si woɖe fia, eye wònye ahom sesẽ kekeake le ɣedzeƒe kple 35°
text_en: Fred is the strongest tropical cyclone ever recorded so far south and east in the Atlantic since the advent of satellite imagery, and only the third major hurricane on record east of 35°W.

text: Le Anyɔnyɔ 24 lia le ƒe 1759, Arthur Guinness de asi ƒe 9,000 agbalẽ te hena St James Gate Brewery wɔwɔ le Dublin Ireland
text_en: On September 24, 1759, Arthur Guinness signed a 9,000 year lease for the St James' Gate Brewery in Dublin, Ireland.

text: Le ƒe 250 megbe la, Guinness va keke ta hezu xexeame asitsaƒe si sa nu anɔ euro biliɔn 10 (anye US biliɔn 14.7) ƒe sia ƒe
text_en: 250 years later, Guinness has grown to a global business that turns over 10 billion euros (US$14.7 billion) every year.

text: Egbea, Johnny Reid si nye ʋukula evelia na New Zeland ƒe hatsotsoa A1GP ƒe ŋkɔ ɖo ŋutinya me. Eku ʋu to New Zeland ƒe melidzeƒe kponyigba si xɔ ƒe 48 la dzi eye naneke mewɔe o.
text_en: Jonny Reid, co-driver for the A1GP New Zealand team, today made history by driving the fastest over the 48-year-old Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, legally.

text: Aƒetɔ Reid, ku New Zeland hatsotsoa A1GP ƒe ʋua kple ŋusẽ abe 160km/h eye wòto kponyigbã la dzi zigbɔ zi adre.
text_en: Mr Reid managed to drive the New Zealand's A1GP car, Black Beauty at speeds over 160km/h seven times over the bridge.

text: New Zeland ƒe kpovitɔwo dzi be yewo azã yewo ƒe yamenutomenudimɔ̃ anya kpeti neni wɔm wòle, gake wometeŋu ŋui o ɖe ʋua ƒe ablaɖeɖe sesiẽ ta. Negbe le esi me wòɖo 160km/h ƒe nuwuwu la koe woteŋu wɔe.
text_en: The New Zealand police had trouble using their speed radar guns to see how fast Mr Reid was going because of how low Black Beauty is, and the only time the police managed to clock Mr Reid was when he slowed down to 160km/h.

text: Le ɣleti 3 si va yi me woɖe asi le aboyome 80 kple edzi vɔ wo ŋu le Central Booking gakpɔ me esime wome xe fe aɖeke o
text_en: In the last 3 months, over 80 arrestees were released from the Central Booking facility without being formally charged.

text: Ʋɔnudrɔ̃la Glynn ɖe gakpɔ dzadzraɖo ƒe se to le afɔfiɛ me be woana woaɖe asi le amesiwo wole eye wo drɔ̃ ʋɔnu haɖe o le gaƒoƒo 24 megbe
text_en: In April this year, a temporary restaining order was issued by Judge Glynn against the facility to enforce the release of those held more than 24 hours after their intake who did not receive a hearing by a court commissioner.

text: Ʋɔ̃nu dzikpɔlagã tso ga ho me si woa xe eye wodzra nyawo ɖo he de computer me
text_en: The commissioner sets bail, if granted, and formalizes the charges filed by the arresting officer. The charges are then entered into the state's computer system where the case is tracked.

text: Nyawo hã gblɔ be amesiwo ŋu wotsɔ nya ɖo ƒe ʋɔnudrɔ̃drɔ̃ nava eme kaba
text_en: The hearing also marks the date for the suspect’s right to a speedy trial.

text: Australiatɔwo ƒe nuŋlɔla Peter Costello ame si dze anɔ dudɔnunɔla gbãtɔ John Howard si nye Liberal dzunyahehabɔbɔ ƒe tatɔ teƒe la hɔ kpekpeɖeŋu tso nukliaʋawɔnuwo dɔwɔƒe si le Australia gbɔ
text_en: Peter Costello, Australian treasurer and the man most likely to succeed Prime Minister John Howard as Liberal party leader has thrown his support behind a nuclear power industry in Australia.

text: Aƒetɔ Costello gblɔ be nukliaʋawɔnuwo wɔwɔ nyo na ga nyawo ŋgɔdede eye edze be Australia dukɔa nanɔ wozã
text_en: Mr Costello said that when nuclear power generation becomes economically viable, Australia should pursue its use.

text: Aƒetɔ Costello gblɔ be "ne wole wodzra la, ehiã anɔ mía si. Naneke mateŋu xe mɔ na nukliaʋawɔnuwo zazã o.
text_en: "If it becomes commercial, we should have it. That is, there's no in-principle objection to nuclear energy" Mr Costello said.

text: Le Ansa ƒe nyawo nu la kpovitɔwo hã nɔa zime na tudada wɔna siwo wovɔ be ateŋu he aʋa gã ava
text_en: According to Ansa, "police were concerned by a couple of top-level hits they feared might spark a full-blown war of succession.

text: Kpovitɔwo gblɔ be Lo Piccolo kpɔ ŋusẽ elabena enye Provenzano ƒe akameti gbãtɔ va yi le Palermo eye eƒe nunya de ŋgɔ woe be amegã tsitsiwo dea bubu eŋu. Wogblɔ nya sia esime wonɔ dzidzim aɖɔ Provenzano ƒe sewo ɖo ɣemaɣi wòanɔ dzadzraɖo wɔm
text_en: Police said Lo Piccolo had the upper hand because he had been Provenzano's right-hand man in Palermo and his greater experience won him the respect of the older generation of bosses as they pursued Provenzano's policy of keeping as low as possible while strengthening their power network.

text: Provenzano ɖo amegã siawo anyi le esime woɖo asi Riina driven aʋa si wowɔ kple du si di aɖe Giovanni Falcone kple Paolo Borsellino siwo nye Mafia atitsogaʋawɔlaawo le ƒe 1992
text_en: These bosses had been reined in by Provenzano when he put an end to the Riina-driven war against the state that claimed the lives of Mafia crusaders Giovanni Falcone and Paolo Borsellino in 1992."

text: Apple ƒe tatɔ Steve Jobs klo nu le mɔ̃a dzi esime wonɔ zɔzɔ le nuƒolanɔƒea eye woɖe iPhone tso eƒe jeans kotoku me
text_en: Apple CEO Steve Jobs unveiled the device by walking onto the stage and taking the iPhone out of his jeans pocket.

text: Le eƒe gaƒoƒo 2 nuƒoƒo me la egblɔ be: "Egbe la Apple le kaƒomɔa wɔ ge. Míele ŋutinya wɔge egbea".
text_en: During his 2 hour speech he stated that "Today Apple is going to reinvent the phone, We are going to make history today".

text: Brazilia enye du si me Roma Katholik sɔgbɔ le le anyigba dzi. Eye "tsɔtsi" sia ti tre ɖe ŋutu kple ŋutu alo nyɔnu kple nyɔnu ƒe srɔ ɖeɖe ŋu vevie.
text_en: Brazil is the largest Roman Catholic country on Earth, and the Roman Catholic Church has consistently opposed the legalization of same-sex marriage in the country.

text: Anɔ abe ƒe 10 enye esia ene Brazilia ƒe agbonuglawo he nya kuɖe srɔ ɖeɖe sia ŋu. Eye va na ne fifia la, Rio Grande do Sul koe mɔɖeɖe le be woawɔ srɔ ɖeɖe sia le.
text_en: The National Congress of Brazil has debated legalization for 10 years, and such civil marriages are currently only legal in Rio Grande do Sul.

text: Tatɔ Marta Suplicy enye ame si gbe nu le ɖoɖo sia gbɔ gbã. Azɔ̃ se yeye si dzi woda asi ɖo la le Roberto Jefferson si me.
text_en: The original bill was drafted by former mayor of São Paulo, Marta Suplicy. The proposed legislation, after being amended, is now in the hands of Roberto Jefferson.

text: Srɔ ɖeɖe tsitretsila siawo di be yewo ade asi agbalẽ te abe miliɔ̃ 1.2 ene. Esi awɔe be woateŋu atsɔ yewoƒe didi aɖo sewɔƒemenɔlawo ƒe anyinɔƒe gã la.
text_en: Protesters hope to collect a petition of 1.2 million signatures to present to the National Congress in November.

text: Wo wɔ takpekpe le tedoxe 20 lia dzi le se dɔwɔƒe si le East Bay nutoame kuɖe amesiwo wodadzoe ta esime edze ƒã be ƒome geɖewo nɔa kpekpeɖeŋu dzi tso se gnawo me atsɔ gbe nu le vodadawo gbɔ
text_en: After it became apparent that many families were seeking legal help to fight the evictions, a meeting was held on March 20 at the East Bay Community Law Center for the victims of the housing scam.

text: Esi xɔhayalawo dze nu ƒoƒo tso nusi va dzɔ ɖe wo dzi la, ƒome geɖewo de dzesii be Carole Wilson si nye OHA hamevi la fi woƒe dedienɔnɔ ga eye wodzo le duame
text_en: When the tenants started sharing what had occurred to them, most of the families involved suddenly realized that Carolyn Wilson of the OHA had stolen their security deposits, and skipped out of town.

text: Esime wose be OHA kpovitɔwo nɔa numekuku wɔm kuɖe aƒe nunɔamesi bubuwo ŋuti le Oakland si ateŋu he aƒe xɔxɔ kple akpasesẽ vae la, xɔhayala siwo le Lockwood Gardens la xɔe se be ƒome 40 alo edzivɔ bubuwo nɔ ame ɖeɖe le aƒeme wɔna me
text_en: Tenants at Lockwood Gardens believe that there may be another 40 families or more to face eviction, since they learned that OHA police are also investigating other public housing properties in Oakland that may be caught up in the housing scam.

text: Haƒoha te fli ɖe fefea me le Maui War ƒe ŋkuɖodzi bɔlƒoƒe sime ame 9,000 akpɔ gome le, eye wodo taflatse na nukpɔlawo
text_en: The band canceled the show at Maui's War Memorial Stadium, which was set to be attended by 9,000 people, and apologized to fans.

text: Haƒoha ɖoɖo wɔwɔ habɔbɔ si nye HK Management Inc megblɔ susu si ta wote fli ɖe anyɔnyɔ 20 ƒe fefea me o ke boŋ etsɔ nya ɖe ʋu kuxiwo ŋu emegbe
text_en: The band's management company, HK Management Inc., gave no initial reason when they canceled on September 20, but blamed logistical reasons by the next day.

text: Wode Sakis Kechagioglou kple George Nikolakopoulos siwo nye Helatɔ senyala xɔŋkɔwo gaxɔ me le Atenetɔwo ƒe gaxɔ le Korydallus esime wobu fɔ wo ɖe viɖe didi kple nufitifitiwɔwɔ ta
text_en: The famous Greek lawyers, Sakis Kechagioglou and George Nikolakopoulos have been imprisoned in the Athens' jail of Korydallus, as they were found guilty of graft and corruption.

text: Le esia megbe la, woɖe nugbegblẽ siwo ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo kple senyalawo wɔ le ƒe siwo va yi le Helatɔwo ƒe senyala habɔbɔa me to afɔɖeɖe siwo mele wo teƒe wo la dzi
text_en: As a result of this, a big scandal within the Greek legal community has been raised through the exposure of illegal actions that judges, lawyers, solicitors and attorneys have done during the previous years.

text: Le kɔsiɖa aɖewo megbe esime nyadzɔdzɔŋlɔla Makis Triantafylopoulos ɖe gbefã nya siawo le eƒe television dzi fefe"Zoungla" si vae me le Alpha TV dzi la, sewɔƒemenɔla kple senyala Petros Mantouvalos hã ɖea asi le eƒe dɔwɔwɔ ŋu esime eƒe dɔwɔ habɔbɔ me tɔwo kpɔ gome le viɖe didi siwo me wo teƒe o kple nufitifitiwɔwɔ me
text_en: A few weeks ago, after the information published by the journalist Makis Triantafylopoulos in his popular Television show "Zoungla" in Alpha TV, the member of Parliament and lawyer, Petros Mantouvalos was abdicated as members of his office had been involved in illegal graft and corruption.

text: Gakpe ɖe eŋu la, wode mɔ senyala gã Evangelos Kalousis esime wo bu fɔe ɖe nufitifitiwɔwɔ kple agbe vlo nɔnɔ ta
text_en: Moreover, top judge Evangelos Kalousis is imprisoned as he found guilty of corruption and degenerate behaviour.

text: Robert gblɔ be, nenye be woade ŋuku fuɖeɖe ƒe nuwɔnawo me la, enye nu si ɖe fu vie be woaƒo nu kuɖe eŋu. Esiata, meteŋu gblɔ ɣeyiɣi si me tututu agbea dzea egɔme o.
text_en: Roberts flatly refused to say about when he believes life begins, an important question when considering the ethics of abortion, saying that it would be unethical to comment on the specifics of likely cases.

text: Ega ɖo kpe nya si wògblɔ tsã la dzi be Roe v. enye "se si woɖo anyi" si ɖoa kpe kodzoɖiƒe gã ƒe gbedeasiwo dzi
text_en: He did, however, reiterate his earlier statement that Roe v. Wade was the "settled law of the land", emphasizing the importance of consistent Supreme Court rulings.

text: Ega gblɔ hã be, yeda asi le Roe ƒe se si ƒo nu ku ɖe ame ŋutɔ ƒe nyaɣaɣlawo ŋu.
text_en: He also confirmed that he believed in the implied right to privacy which the Roe decision depended upon.

text: Maroochydore le ame gbãtɔ kple dzesi ade, eye Noosa le ame evelia.
text_en: Maroochydore had finished on top of the ladder, six points clear of Noosa in second.

text: Ha eve siawo do go le hoʋiʋli si dze ŋukɔ na mamlea, eye Noosa ye kpɔ dziɖuɖu kple dzesi 11.
text_en: The two sides would meet in the major semi final where Noosa ran out winners by 11 points.

text: Maroochydore ɖu Caboolture dzi. Wɔe be meteŋu yi ɖe hoʋiʋlia ƒe akpa mamlea o.
text_en: Maroochydore then defeated Caboolture in the Preliminary Final.

text: Hesperonychus elizabethae nye Dromaeosaurida ƒomevi kple Velociraptor ƒometɔ
text_en: Hesperonychus elizabethae is a species of the family Dromaeosauridae and is a cousin of Velociraptor .

text: Amewo xɔe se be xelénu sia zɔ̃ afɔ eve kple fe abe Velociraptor ene
text_en: This fully feathered, warm blooded bird of prey was believed to have walked upright on two legs with claws like the Velociraptor.

text: Eƒe afɔ fe eve lia didi gã wɔ be wowɔe be Hesperonychus si gɔme enye"ɣetoɖoƒe fe"
text_en: Its second claw was larger, giving rise to the name Hesperonychus which means "western claw."

text: To vovo na tikpe ƒe fuɖe na ame ƒe kuxia la, ya kple nu bubuwo wɔe be agbagba si dzem tikpekuxikpɔlawo le la le dzodzro zum.
text_en: In addition to the crushing ice, extreme weather conditions have been hampering rescue efforts.

text: Pittam gblɔ be, ɖewohĩ nɔnɔmea ateŋu aka ɖe eme le kwasiɖa si gbɔna la me.
text_en: Pittman suggested that conditions wouldn't improve until sometime next week.

text: Pittam ga gblɔ hã be, tikpe si ɖe fu na ƒudzidɔwɔlawo le ƒe 15 siwo vayi me la ƒe titri me menɔ abe esia ene o.
text_en: The amount and thickness of the pack ice, according to Pittman, is the worst it has been for sealers in the past 15 years.

text: Nyadzɔdzɔ kaka ɖe Red Lake nutoa me be wogalé sukivi bubu kuɖe tudada si kpɔ eme vava le sukua me le Tedoxe 21lia dzi la me, esime wonɔ Jeff Weise kple ame asieke siwo kpɔ ku la dometɔ etɔ̃ ƒe kukɔnu wɔm
text_en: News spread in the Red Lake community today as funerals for Jeff Weise and three of the nine victims were held that another student was arrested in connection with the school shootings of March 21.

text: Nya ʋee aɖewo ko dumegãwo gblɔ tsɔ wu be woaɖo kpe egbe ƒe amedzidzedzea dzi
text_en: Authorities said little officially beyond confirming today's arrest.

text: Ke la nunya aɖe tso nugɔmekukua ŋuti gblɔ na Minneapolis Star – Tribune be Louis Jourdain , Red Lake Tribal Chairman Floyd Jourdain si xɔ ƒe 16 lae.
text_en: However, a source with knowledge of the investigation told the Minneapolis Star-Tribune that it was Louis Jourdain, 16-year old son of Red Lake Tribal Chairman Floyd Jourdain.

text: Le ɣeyiɣi sia me la, womenya nya si woatsɔ alo nu si he tatɔwo yi ɖevia gbɔ la o gake dziɖuɖu ƒe ʋɔnudrɔƒea dze ɖeviwo ƒe nyadɔdrɔ̃ gɔme.
text_en: It is not known at this time what charges will be laid or what led authorities to the boy but juvenile proceedings have begun in federal court.

text: Lodin gblɔ be, Afghanistã ƒe kplɔlawo ɖoe be yewo maga yiɖe akɔdaƒe zi evelia o, bene yewoa atsɔ agbe nu le ga zazã ƒomevi ɖe sia ɖe gbɔ, eye hena Afghanistã dukɔa ƒe dedienɔnɔ.
text_en: Lodin also said officials decided to cancel the runoff in order to save Afghans the expense and security risk of another election.

text: Seŋudɔwɔlawo gblɔ be yewo kpɔ nu kli nu geɖe le Afghanistã ƒe senuawo me. Esi wɔe be, atrɔ yi ɖe akɔdaƒe zi evelia me ganye nu si le vevie o.
text_en: Diplomats said that they had found enough ambiguity in the Afghan constitution to determine the runoff as unnecessary.

text: Nyanuɖeɖe sia tsi tre ɖe nya si wogblɔ tsã dzi be, agbe akɔdaƒe yiyi zi evelia nye tsitretsitsi ɖe senuawo ŋu.
text_en: This contradicts earlier reports, which said that cancelling the runoff would have been against the constitution.

text: Yameʋu sia yi na ɖe Irtusk eye aʋawɔlawoe nɔ eme.
text_en: The aircraft had been headed to Irkutsk and was being operated by interior troops.

text: Nu sia nu sɔgbe hena numekuku.
text_en: An inquiry was established to investigate.

text: II-76 nye aʋayameʋu tɔxe aɖe na Rɔshiawo kple sovietiktɔwo tso keke ƒe 1970 lia me. Gake edze afɔku me le ɣleti si míede megbe la me le Sovietik.
text_en: The Il-76 has been a major component of both the Russian and Soviet military since the 1970s, and had already seen a serious accident in Russia last month.

text: Le Siamlɔm 7 lia dzi la, yameʋula gbedzo le ya me. Gake ame aɖeke mekpɔ afɔku o. Esia wɔe be Rushiawo mega zɔ̃a mɔ kple II-76 la o.
text_en: On October 7 an engine separated on takeoff, without injuries. Russia briefly grounded Il-76s after that accident.

text: Le tomemi gago akpe ɖeka ɖuɖu vɔ megbe le Fairbanks anyiehe le Alaska la, wotu Trans-Alaska amipɔmpigakpo meta 800
text_en: 800 miles of the Trans-Alaska Pipeline System were closed down following a spill of thousands of barrels of crude oil south of Fairbanks, Alaska.

text: Elektrikŋusẽnamɔ̃ gbe dzo wɔ be gagoawo ƒe do ʋu eye tomemi ɖuɖu le Fort Greety amisaƒe 9
text_en: A power failure following a routine fire-command system test caused relief valves to open and crude oil overflowed near the Fort Greely pump station 9.

text: Amigago doawo ʋuʋu wɔ be ami ɖuɖu asu gago 55,000 (gago miliɔn 2.3)
text_en: The valves opening allowed a pressure release for the system and oil flowed on a pad to a tank that can hold 55,000 barrels (2.3 million gallons).

text: Ami ga nɔ ɖuɖum le kuɖagbe ɣetrɔ kuɖe dzodzo si le amigagowo me ta
text_en: As of Wednesday afternoon, the tank vents were still leaking probably from thermal expansion inside the tank.

text: Ami teƒe bubu si ateŋu xɔ ami gago 104,500 la mekpɔ ɖɔ haɖe o
text_en: Another secondary containment area below the tanks capable of holding 104,500 barrels was not yet filled to capacity.

text: Esia nye zi gbãtɔ si Irantɔwo ƒe nyatakaka dɔwɔƒe gã ʋu eme le television dzi gblɔ be toheheawo mele naneke gblẽ ge o
text_en: The comments, live on television, were the first time that senior Iranian sources have admitted that the sanctions are having any effect.

text: Toheheawo lɔ asi ɖoɖo ga gnawo dzi kple tomemi sasa le Europa Dukɔwo ƒe Ðekawɔha ɖe me si na Irantɔwo ƒe ganyawo dea ŋgɔ 80 ɖe alafa dzi
text_en: They include financial restrictions and a ban by the European Union on the export of crude oil, from which the Iranian economy receives 80% of its foreign income.

text: OPEC gblɔ le eƒe ɣleti sia ɣleti ƒe akɔntabubuwo mamlea me be gbe sia gbe tomemi kuku yi duta nu ɖiɖi abe gago miliɔn 2.8 ene
text_en: In its most recent monthly report, OPEC said exports of crude had fallen to their lowest level for two decades at 2.8 million barrels per day.

text: Ayatollah Ali si nye dukɔa kplɔla ƒo nu tso ami sasa ƒe kuxi sia ŋu abe 'mɔ̃' si nɔ anyi tso keke Irantɔwo ƒe aʋawɔwɔ ɣeyiɣi le ƒe 1979 me eye bena dukɔa naɖe eɖokui
text_en: The country's supreme leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, has described the dependency on oil as "a trap" dating from before Iran's Islamic revolution in 1979 and from which the country should free itself.

text: Esi nugoea dzo le anyigba yina yamenuto me le ŋdi ga 5 lɔƒo la wokpɔ mɔ nɛ be woaklẽ na amesiwo le dziehe California, Oregon, Nevada kple Utah
text_en: When the capsule gets to Earth and enters the atmosphere, at about 5am (eastern time), it is expected to put on quite a light show for folks in Northern California, Oregon, Nevada, and Utah.

text: Nugoea anɔ abe ɣletivi si woda woyina yame ene
text_en: The capsule will look much like a shooting star going across the sky.

text: Nugoea azɔ̃ mɔ kaba abe kilometa 12.8 le aɖabaƒoƒo ɖeka me ene, anye miniti ɖeka tso San Francisco yiɖe Los Angeles
text_en: The capsule will be traveling at about 12.8 km or 8 miles per second, fast enough to go from San Francisco to Los Angeles in one minute.

text: Stardust nye dzinudzidela gbãtɔ si ɖi kaba eye wodo ŋgɔ na Apollo dzinudzidelawo ƒe ha si nye ame gbãtɔ le damɛ ƒe 1969 me
text_en: Stardust will set a new all-time record for being the fastest spacecraft to return to Earth, breaking the previous record set in May of 1969 during the return of the Apollo X command module.

text: Tom Duxbury si nye Stardust ɖoɖowo dzi kpɔla gblɔ be ayi ɖe ɣetoɖoƒe ƒutanuto siwo le dziehe California eye woaklẽ ɖe yame tso California yiɖe titina Oregon, Nevada, Idaho kple Utah
text_en: “It will move over the west coast of northern California and will light the sky from California through central Oregon and on through Nevada and Idaho and into Utah,” Tom Duxbury, Stardust's project manager said.

text: Aƒetɔ Rudd wɔ tsiatsia be yea da asi le Kyoto ƒe ɖoɖo si kpɔa yame ƒe dedienɔnɔ nyawo gbɔ. Gake Amerika dukɔa me le esia me o, eye eya ɖeka koe nye dukɔ de ŋkɔ si gbe be ye mada asi le ɖoɖo sia dzi o.
text_en: Mr. Rudd's decision to sign the Kyoto climate accord isolates the United States, which will now be the only developed nation not to ratify the agreement.

text: Australia dudɔnunɔla xoxuiawo hã gbe be yewo ma da asi le ɖoɖo sia dzi o, elabena esia ateŋu ahe kuxi ava na woƒe ga nyawo, si wotsɔ ƒlea tomekawo. Eye gawu la, bena yamegbegblẽ ƒe nyawo menye China kple Indiatɔwo ƒe kuxi o.
text_en: Australia's former conservative government refused to ratify Kyoto, saying it would damage the economy with its heavy reliance on coal exports, while countries like India and China were not bound by emissions targets.

text: Enye nu nyui aɖe si su eBay si le eƒe dɔwɔwɔ ŋutinya me
text_en: It is the biggest acquisition in eBay's history.

text: Dɔwɔƒea dzi axɔ ŋgɔ to ga dzi mɔnu vovovowo ɖeɖe ɖe go le nuto siwo me amewo zã Skype le sɔgbɔ abe China, Ɣedzeƒe Europa kple Brazil
text_en: The company hopes to diversify its profit sources and gain popularity in areas where Skype holds a strong position, such as China, Eastern Europe, and Brazil.

text: Dzɔdzɔmeŋutinunyalawo gblɔ be, ɖewohĩ anye ne Enceladus ƒe dɔwɔwɔ tae, eye, eya kee ana Saturn ƒe ring la hã.
text_en: Scientists have suspected Enceladus as geologically active and a possible source of Saturn's icy E ring.

text: Enceladus ye nye nu gã ke kea ke le ɣe ƒe dɔwɔwo me, eye dzodzo si wònana ɣe la anɔ abe 90 ɖe alafa dzi ene.
text_en: Enceladus is the most reflective object in the solar system, reflecting about 90 percent of the sunlight that hits it.

text: Konami fefe tala gblɔ le Japantɔwo ƒe nyadzɔdzɔgbalẽ me egbea be wòmegale fefea ta ge le Fallujah va se ɖe ŋkeke ade o
text_en: The game publisher Konami stated today in a Japanese newspaper that they will not be releasing the game Six Days in Fallujah.

text: Second Battle of Fallujah nye fefe si ɖea Amerikatɔwo kple Iraq srafowo dome ʋa vɔ̃ɖi fia
text_en: The game is based on the Second Battle of Fallujah, a vicious battle between American and Iraqi forces.

text: ACMA kpɔe be togbɔ bena wowɔ sinima le Internet dzi hã la, Big Brother meda sinima wɔwɔ ƒe sewo dzi o elabe wome da sinima ɖe Big Brother ƒe nyatakakadzraɖoƒe o
text_en: The ACMA also found that despite the video being streamed on the Internet, Big Brother had not breached online content censorship laws as the media had not been stored on Big Brother's website.

text: Ɖoɖo si kpɔna dzidziƒenyasemɔwo kple dzidziƒenukpɔmɔ nyawo gbɔ la ɖoe be ele be ɖoɖo nanɔ nu siwo anɔ internet dzi la me. Evɔ be hafi woabu nane abe internet dzi nu ene la, ele be wòanɔ server dzi
text_en: The Broadcasting Services Act provides for the regulation of Internet content, however to be considered Internet content, it must physically reside on a server.

text: United States dutadɔwɔƒe si le Kenya Nairobi xlɔ̃ nu gblɔ be "aglãdzeha siwo tso Somalia" le amedzidzedze ɖoɖo wɔm ada bɔmb si edala ɖonɛ be yeaku faa la le Kenya kple Ethiopia
text_en: The United States embassy located in Nairobi, Kenya has issued a warning that "extremists from Somalia" are planning to launch suicide bomb attacks in Kenya and Ethiopia.

text: U.S dutadɔwɔƒe gblɔ be exɔ nyanyanana tso numekuku dɔwɔƒe si ƒe ŋkɔ womeyɔ o la gbɔ. Nyanyanana si ƒonu tso bɔmb si edala ɖonɛ be yeaku faa dada le takpekpe xɔ ŋkɔwo le Ethiopia kple Kenya
text_en: The U.S. says it has received information from an undisclosed source that specifically mentions the use of suicide bombers to will blow up "prominent landmarks" in Ethiopia and Kenya.

text: Hafi woaɖo The daily Show kple The Colbert Report la, Heck kple Johnson wɔ susu do ŋgɔ esime wonye sukuviwo le UW le ƒe 1988 me be woanye nya kaka dɔwɔƒe siwo aƒo nu tso nyadzɔdzɔwo kple nyatakakwo ŋu
text_en: Long before The Daily Show and The Colbert Report, Heck and Johnson envisioned a publication that would parody the news—and news reporting—when they were students at UW in 1988.

text: The Onion zu nyatakaka dɔwɔƒe gã le eƒe ɖoɖo anyi megbe kple agbalẽ ta ƒe, nyatakakadraɖoƒe si dzi ame 5,000,000 nɔ le Kele me, nusasa gbefã ɖeɖe, nyadzɔdzɔdɔwɔƒe si wɔ dɔ gaƒoƒo 24, nuƒoƒo siwo wole ɖe mɔ̃ dzi, kple xexeame katã ƒe nyatakaka dɔwɔƒe si woyɔ be Our Dumb World
text_en: Since its inception, The Onion has become a veritable news parody empire, with a print edition, a website that drew 5,000,000 unique visitors in the month of October, personal ads, a 24 hour news network, podcasts, and a recently launched world atlas called Our Dumb World.

text: Woƒo nu tso AI Gore kple General Tommy Franks ŋu le woƒe nyadzɔdzɔgbalẽ veviewo me. (Woƒo nu tso Gore ŋuti le ɣeyiɣi sime wowɔ gbɔdɔdɔ kple Tipper le eƒe gege le ƒe 2000 kɔledzi akɔdada megbe
text_en: Al Gore and General Tommy Franks casually rattle off their favorite headlines (Gore's was when The Onion reported he and Tipper were having the best sex of their lives after his 2000 Electoral College defeat).

text: Woƒe nyadzɔdzɔgbalẽ ŋlɔlawo ƒo nu tso Jon Stewart kple Stephen Colbert ƒe ŋusẽ gã ɖe nyatakaka dɔwɔƒea dzi
text_en: Many of their writers have gone on to wield great influence on Jon Stewart and Stephen Colbert's news parody shows.

text: Nutata wɔna nye gbeƒãɖeɖe mɔnu na Bucharest dua be woaɖe Romania fiadu nɔnɔmetata fia abe dugã nya kpɔ ene
text_en: The artistic event is also part of a campaign by the Bucharest City Hall that seeks to relaunch the image of the Romanian capital as a creative and colourful metropolis.

text: Anye du gbãtɔ le anyiehe ɣedzeƒe Europa si me woawɔ CowParade si nye dukɔ ƒoƒuawo nutata takpekpe le masa kple dasiamime
text_en: The city will be the first in southeastern Europe to host CowParade, the world's largest public art event, between June and August this year.

text: Egbe ƒe gbefãɖeɖe ɖo kpe dziɖuɖua ƒe adzɔgbefiafia si wòwɔ le masa me be yeaƒle keteke bubuwo
text_en: Today's announcement also extended the government's commitment made in March of this year to fund extra carriages.

text: Woaƒle keteke 1,300 ne ame 300 atsɔ ɖe amewo ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ kuxi dzi kpɔtɔ
text_en: An additional 300 brings the total to 1,300 carriages to be acquired to relieve overcrowding.

text: Christopher Garcia si nye nyanuɖela na Los Angeles kpovitɔwo dɔwɔƒe gblɔ be yeowɔ numekuku tso ŋutsu si wosusu be ye gblẽ nua ŋu abe amesi wɔ vodada ene, menye abe nugbegblẽwɔla o
text_en: Christopher Garcia, a spokesperson of the Los Angeles Police Department, said the suspected male offender is being investigated for trespassing rather than vandalism.

text: Megblẽ nutata o. Ezã tapolin yibɔ si dzi wota ŋutifafa kple dzi ƒe dzesiwo ɖo hetsu "O" dzi wɔe be wodze "e"
text_en: The sign was not physically damaged; the modification was done using black tarpaulins decorated with signs of peace and heart to alter the "O" to read lowercase "e".

text: Karenia brevis, si nye ƒume nugbagbe sue amadede nɔnɔme trɔtrɔ, ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ na be atsiaƒu trɔ eƒe amadede
text_en: Red tide is caused by a higher than normal concentration of Karenia brevis, a naturally-occurring single-celled marine organism.

text: Nudzɔdzɔ nɔ ɖokuisiwo ateŋu na nɔnɔme nyuitɔwo si wɔe be ƒumegbe sia vuna le agbɔsɔsɔ me
text_en: Natural factors can intersect to produce ideal conditions, allowing this algae to increase in number dramatically.

text: Ƒumegbea wɔ aɖi si gblẽa nu le amegbetɔ kple tɔmelãwo ƒe lãmekawo ŋu
text_en: The algae produces a neurotoxin that can disable nerves in both humans and fish.

text: Aɖi ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ le ƒua me na be tɔmelãwo ku na ɣesiaɣi
text_en: Fish often die because of the high concentrations of the toxin in the waters.

text: Amegbetɔwo ateŋu xɔ dɔlele to aɖi ya si wogbɔna me
text_en: Humans can be affected by breathing affected water taken into the air by wind and waves.

text: Le eƒe sesẽ nu la, ya Tropical Cyclone Gonu si xɔ eƒe ŋkɔ tso deti lɔdzewo me le Maldives gbe me la, ƒe abla ablaɖeɖe anɔ abe kilometa 240 ene le gaƒoƒo ɖeka me.
text_en: At its peak, Tropical Cyclone Gonu, named for a bag of palm leaves in the language of the Maldives, reached sustained winds of 240 kilometers an hour (149 miles per hour) .

text: Le ŋdi futuu la, yawo ƒe dzuƒuƒu anɔ abe kpeti 83 ene le gaƒoƒo ɖeka me, eye anye ne ɖewohĩ, ateŋu aɖiɖi fãa.
text_en: By early today, winds were around 83 km/h, and it was expect to keep weakening.

text: Le Kuɖagbe ƒe ŋukekea dzi la, United States ƒe Basket bɔluƒoha (NBA) gbugbɔ Basket ƒe gododo gã si va na eme la da ɖe ŋkeke bubu dzi ɖe COVID-19 ƒe nyawo ta.
text_en: On Wednesday, the United States' National Basketball Association (NBA) suspended its professional basketball season due to concerns regarding COVID-19.

text: Woɖe nya sia ɖe go le esi me wokpɔ COVID-19 ƒe dɔa le Utah Jazz ƒe kametela ɖeka aɖe ŋu.
text_en: The NBA's decision followed a Utah Jazz player testing positive for the COVID-19 virus.

text: Blema nu kukuwo ƒe susɔe siawo ɖe fia be trɔtrɔa va eme do ŋgɔ na esi lãmenugbagbeviwo ɖe fia
text_en: "Based on this fossil, that means the split is much earlier than has been anticipated by the molecular evidence.

text: Dzilawo kpɔe be egblɔa nya tɔamewo le eƒe nufiafiawo me enye wogblɔa nya madzetowo le sukuxɔme
text_en: In his notes he used words which some parents considered coarse, and he reportedly used profanity in class.

text: Modern English tsɔ nya ɖe eŋu be mebia gbe hafi ta boblododowo ɖe ʋuwo dzi o eye wòɖa adze be ye enyi Eŋlisigbe fiala gã
text_en: Modern Education accused him of printing large advertisements on buses without authorisation and lying by saying that he was the chief English tutor.

text: Wotso enu do ŋgɔ hã be eda le nutɔnyenyese dzi gake wome tsɔ nya ɖe eŋu o
text_en: He has also been accused previously of copyright infringement, but was not charged.

text: Sukuvi aɖe si de sukua kpɔ gblɔ be 'egblɔa nya gbegblẽ le sukuxɔme, efia nu xoxowo eye wòwɔ abe sukuviwo xɔlɔ'
text_en: A former student said that he 'used slang in class, taught dating skills in notes, and was just like the students' friend.'

text: Togbɔ be China kpɔtɔ ga nye kɔmiunist du hã la, ede ŋgɔ le ga nyawo me le ƒe etɔ̃ siwo va yi me
text_en: During the last three decades, despite officially remaining a communist state, China has developed a market economy.

text: Deng Xiaoping kplɔ ganya ɖɔɖɔɖo gbãtɔwo
text_en: The first economic reforms were made under the leadership of Deng Xiaoping.

text: Tso ɣemaɣi ke la China ganyawo de ŋgɔ zi 90
text_en: Since then, China's economic size has grown by 90 times.

text: Esia enye zi gbãtɔ China dzra ʋu sɔgbɔ wu Germany eye wode ŋgɔ na United States si lé nɔƒe gbãtɔ le ʋu wɔwɔ me
text_en: For the first time, last year China exported more cars than Germany and surpassed the United States as the biggest market for this industry.

text: China ƒe nusasa asɔgbɔ wu United States tɔ le ƒe eve me
text_en: China's GDP could be larger than the United States within two decades.

text: Ahomya xɔdzo Danielle si nye ƒe 2010 Atlantik hurricane season ahom enelia ƒo le Atlantik ƒua ƒe ɣedzeƒe
text_en: Tropical Storm Danielle, fourth named storm of the 2010 Atlantic hurricane season, has formed in the eastern Atlantic Ocean.

text: Ahomya tsɔ ɖe Miami le Florida gbɔ abe kilometa 3,000 eye enu sẽe wònɔ du dzi kilometa 64 le gaƒoƒo ɖeka me
text_en: The storm, located approximately 3,000 miles from Miami, Florida, has maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (64 kph).

text: Dzɔdzɔmeŋutinunyala siwo le Dukɔa ƒe Dɔwɔƒe si kpɔa ahom nyawo gbɔ gblɔ be Danielle nu asẽ le kuɖagbe
text_en: Scientists at the National Hurricane Center predict that Danielle will strengthen to a hurricane by Wednesday.

text: Esi ahomya matɔ te fifia wo ta la, mele bɔbɔe be woade dzesi eƒe nugbegblẽwo le United States alo le Caribean-fukpowo dzi o
text_en: As the storm is far from landfall, it remains difficult to assess potential impact to the United States or Caribbean.

text: Bobek si wodzi le Zagreb, Croatia fiadu me xɔ ŋkɔ esime wonɔ bɔlƒo na Partizan Belgrade bɔlƒoha
text_en: Born in the Croatian capital, Zagreb, Bobek gained fame while playing for Partizan Belgrade.

text: Eɖo bɔlƒoha me le ƒe 1945 eye wonɔ anyi vaseɖe ƒe 1958
text_en: He joined them in 1945 and stayed until 1958.

text: Edo age 403 le bɔlƒofo 468 me esime wonɔ bɔlƒoha me
text_en: During his time with the team, he scored 403 goals in 468 appearances.

text: Ame bubu aɖeke meƒo bɔl alo do age na bɔlƒoha wu Bobek o
text_en: No one else has ever made more appearances or scored more goals for the club than Bobek.

text: Woda asi ɖe edzi le ƒe 1995 abe bɔlƒola nyuie kekeake le Partizan ƒe ŋutinya me
text_en: In 1995 he was voted the best player in Partizan's history.

text: Wodze ʋoʋiʋlia gɔme kple Cirque du Soleil habɔbɔ xɔ ŋkɔ ƒe modzakaɖeɖe tɔxɛ aɖe
text_en: The celebrations started with a special show by the world-renowned group Cirque du Soleil.

text: Hadzila Fatih Erkoç kple Müzlüm Gurses yi hadzidzi wɔna dzi kple Janissary si nye Istanbul dukɔa ƒe hadziha
text_en: It was followed by the Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, a Janissary band, and the singers Fatih Erkoç and Müslüm Gürses.

text: Emegbe Whirling Dervishes yi edzi
text_en: Then Whirling Dervishes took to the stage.

text: Sezen Asku si nye Turkeytɔwo ƒe hadzila xɔ ŋkɔ dzi ha kple Italiatɔwo ƒe hadzila Alessandro Safina kple Helatɔwo ƒe hadzila Haris Alexiou
text_en: Turkish diva Sezen Aksu performed with the Italian tenor Alessandro Safina and Greek singer Haris Alexiou.

text: Turkeytɔwo ƒe ɣeɖuɖu habɔbɔ wu wɔnawo nu kple "Troy"
text_en: To finish, Turkish dance group Fire of Anatolia performed the show "Troy".

text: Dzokeke kametete wɔla, Peter Lenz si xɔ ƒe 13 ku le dzokeke fɔku aɖe megbe le Idianapolis dzokeke mɔdzi
text_en: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.

text: Lenz dze anyi esi wonɔ numetoto wɔm eye Xavier Zayat zɔ edzi
text_en: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.

text: Kametete dɔkta dɔwɔlawo kɔe yiɖe nutome kɔdzi aɖe afisi woku le emegbe
text_en: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.

text: Zahat mexɔ abi le afɔkua me o
text_en: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

text: Kuɖe xexea ƒe ganyawo ƒe tɔtɔ ta Zapatero yi edzi gblɔ"gaŋutiɖoɖowo le vevie le ganyawo me"
text_en: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

text: Mieɖo ga kuxi ƒe geɖewo eye enu sẽ le ɣleti eve siwo va yi me. Ke fifia me susu be ganyawo ayi nyuie
text_en: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

text: Naked News wɔ nyatakaka kɔsiɖa si va yi gblɔ be ele nyatakaka mɔɖeɖe gbalẽ xɔ ge awɔ gbeƒãɖeɖe le xexeame ƒe gbe etɔ̃ yeyewo me
text_en: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

text: Nyatakakadzraɖoƒea wɔa nyatakaka gbeƒãɖeɖe le Eŋlisigbe kple Japangbe me ke ele ɖoɖo wɔm awɔe le television, nyatakakadzraɖoƒe kple asitelefonwo dzi le Spangbe, Italiagbe, kple Koreagbe me
text_en: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

text: Afɔkua aɖeke medzɔ o gake alesi amewo gbãa fesrewo hafi do go la dziŋɔ nam
text_en: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text: Amewo nɔa fesreawo ƒo kple zikpuiwo gake wome gbãa o
text_en: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

text: Franciszek Kowal si kpɔ gome le afɔkua me gblɔ be "mlɔeba la, fesreawo dometɔ ɖeka gbãa eye mí katã mído go"
text_en: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: Ɣletiviwo ƒe keklẽ na dzodzo kuɖe ŋusẽ si haidrodzin atɔmwo zãna nyenye wowɔ ɖeka zu nukpekpewo
text_en: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: Dzɔdzɔmeŋutinunyalawo le agbagba dzem awɔ ŋusẽnamɔ̃ sia tɔgbe
text_en: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Gake ŋusẽnamɔ sia wɔwɔ nye kuxi gã aɖe eye axɔ ƒe geɖewo hafi woate ŋu wɔe
text_en: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: Ga buia nɔ tsi ŋgɔ haɖe tsia ƒe ŋusẽ ta
text_en: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: Molecule siwo nɔa tsi ŋgɔ la ƒoƒu wu ya ƒe molecule siwo nɔ woƒe tame wɔe be tsiŋusẽ va eme
text_en: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Tsi ƒe moleculewo wɔ dzesi makpɔmakpɔ ɖe tsia ŋgɔ si na be abui nɔ tsi dzi
text_en: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Do le yi nu eve si nɔa snow dzi fɔkpa gɔme. Enu eve siawo na be woazɔ le snow dzi nyuie
text_en: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Esi wònye be hɛ wɔ gobɛ ta la, eƒe nu si nɔa snow dzi hã xana gobɛ
text_en: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Esia wɔe be snow dzi zɔ̃la nɔ trɔtrɔ. Eyia nuɖusi me nenye snow dzi kekea trɔ ɖe nuɖusi gome eye woyia miasi me nenye etrɔ ɖe miasi gome
text_en: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Ehiã be woagbe nu le ŋusẽ si tso dzo ƒe keklẽ gbɔ agbugbɔ awɔ woƒe ɖoɖo
text_en: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Wodo dzo sue aɖe si woyɔna be "photon"
text_en: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Dzɔdzɔmeŋutinunyalawo yɔ wɔna sia be "stimulated emission of radiation" elabe dzo keklẽa ʋã atɔmwo wɔe be photɔn dzo klẽ na
text_en: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Nutata si kplɔe ɖo la ɖe photɔn atɔmwo ƒe keklẽ fia. Le nyateƒe me photɔnwo le sue wu esiwo le nutata me
text_en: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Photɔnwo ga le sue wu nusiwo katã le atɔmwo me
text_en: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Ka si le elektrik kaɖi me fia le gaƒoƒo alafa geɖe dɔwɔwɔ megbe wɔe be mega klẽ o
text_en: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Ehiã be woaɖɔli elektrik kaɖia. Ele vivie be woanɔ ŋudzɔ le eɖɔli ɣeyiɣi me
text_en: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Woati akaɖi siƒea gbã alo woatso ka
text_en: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Elabe elektrikŋusẽ si nɔa nugoe sime wode elektrik kaɖi la ate ŋu ƒo ame vevie nenye be asi ka nugoe me alo elektrik kaɖia ƒe ga teƒe ɣeyiɣi sime wonɔ nugoea me
text_en: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Míaƒe lãmedɔwɔnu si nana be ƒu trsa na nyuie le mía me la enye dzi, elabena eyae gbɔa ʋu la.
text_en: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Ʋu toa ka siwo woyɔna be "alteriawo" la me yina eye etoa ka bubu si woyɔna be "vɛn" la me gbugbɔ va dzia gbɔ. Woyɔ ka sueawo be "kapilɛrwo."
text_en: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Menye aŋgbawo koe blema lãklitsu si ɖua gbe, si si dzo etɔ̃ le la ƒe aɖu ate ŋu aɖu nyãŋunyãŋu o, ke boŋ ati ƒe alɔwo kple kewo hã.
text_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Dzɔdzɔmeŋutinunyala aɖewo buna be Blema lãklitsu si ɖua gbe, si si dzo etɔ̃ le la ɖu cycads, si nye numemie aɖe si bɔ le Cretaceous ɣeyiɣi me.
text_en: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Numemie siawo ɖi deti viwo, eye aŋgba siwo ɖa, heŋu ŋuwo le lae le atia ŋu.
text_en: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Blema lãklitsu si ɖua gbe, si si dzo etɔ̃ le la ate ŋu azã eƒe dɔ sesẽ atsɔ avuvu aŋgbawo ɖa hafi avaɖu atia.
text_en: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Dzɔdzɔmeŋutinunyala bubuwo gblɔ be aɖi le numemie siawo me eya ta mate ŋu adzɔ be blema lãklitsu aɖeke ɖu wo o, togbɔ be egbe la, kadzidɔewo kple lã bubuwo abe ako(blema lãklitsuwo ƒe dzidzimevi) woate ŋu aɖu aŋgba alo atikutsetse siwo me aɖi le la ha.
text_en: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Ale ke lo ƒe nuheŋusẽ ate ŋu ahem ɖe anyi? Nenye be nètɔ ɖe lo dzi la, wò kpekpeme dzi aɖiɖi kpɔtɔ wu ale si wòle le Anyigba dzi.
text_en: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Ame si ƒe kpekpeme nye pound 200 (kg 90) le Anyigba dzi ƒe kpekpeme anɔ abe pound 36 (kg 16) le lo dzi. Eya ta, le nyateƒe me la, ŋuheŋusẽ dzi aɖiɖi kpɔtɔ ɖe dzi wò.
text_en: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Ɣe ƒe akpa aɖeke mesẽ abe ale si Anyigba dzi le, si dzi àte ŋu atɔ ɖa o. Ɣe la katã la nye aɖiyawo, dzo kpakple plasma.
text_en: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Aɖiya la ƒe kpekpeme nu ɖiɖina nenya be nèle dzodzom le Ɣe la ƒe titina.
text_en: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Nene be míekpɔ Ɣe la la, nu si míekpɔna ƒoxlãe la woyɔna be photosphere, si gɔmee nye "kekeli ƒe bɔl".
text_en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Le abe ƒe akpe etɔ̃ megbe la, le ƒe 1610 me la, Italy ɣletiviŋutinunyala Galileo Galilei zã didiƒekpɔmɔ hetsɔ kpɔ be Venus trɔna abe dzinu ke ene.
text_en: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Tɔtrɔwo dzɔna elabena Venus (alo Dzinu) ƒe akpa si koe dze ŋku me Ɣe lae le keklẽm. Venus ƒe tɔtrɔ de megbe na Copernicus ƒe nufiafia be dziƒonyigba nogoawo ƒoaxlã Ɣe la.
text_en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Ke le ƒe ʋe aɖewo megbe le ƒe 1639 me la, Eŋlisi ɣletiviŋutinunyala aɖe si ƒe ŋkɔe nye Jeremiah Horrocks la kpɔe de dzesi be Venus zɔ to anyigba dzi va yi.
text_en: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: England nɔ anyi le ŋutifafa me ɣeyiɣi didi aɖe, le esime wogaɖu Danelaw dzi vɔ megbe.
text_en: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Ke le 991 me la, Ethelred do go Viking-ʋakɔ gã aɖe si nu aʋakɔ aɖeke mete ŋu de, tso Guthrum ƒe aʋakɔ anyinɔɣi ƒe alafa ɖeka va yi me o.
text_en: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Olaf Trygvassen, ame si tso Norway, si di be yeaɖe yeƒe dukɔ ɖa le Denmarktɔwo ƒe kpɔkplɔ te lae nɔ asrafoawo nu.
text_en: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Togbɔ be heheɖemegbe aɖewo do mo ɖa le gɔmedzedzea me hã la, Ethelred teŋu lɔ wɔ ɖeka kple Olaf, ame si gbugbɔ yi Norway hedze agbagba be yeƒe asi nasu yeƒe fiaɖuƒe dzi, ke medze edzi tututu o.
text_en: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Hangeul koe nye ŋɔŋlɔdzesi si woɖo hewɔ, si zãm ame geɖe le. Wowɔ ŋɔŋlɔdzesi la le ƒe 1444 me le Fia Sejong (1418-1450) ƒe fiaɖuɖu ŋɔli.
text_en: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Fia Sejong nye fia enelia le Joseontɔwo ƒe Fiaɖuƒe la.
text_en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Gbã la, eyɔ Hangeul ŋɔŋlɔdzesi la be Hunmin Jeongeum, si gɔmee nye "gbeɖiɖi nyuitɔwo hena nufiafia amewo".
text_en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Nufiafia geɖewo ƒo nu tso ale si Sanskirt dzɔe ŋu. Wo dometɔ ɖeka kuɖe ale si Aryantɔ aɖewo ʋu tso ɣedzeƒe va India eye wòva kple woƒe gbe la ŋu.
text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Sanskirt nye gbe xoxo eye woate ŋu atsɔe asɔ kple Latin-gbe si wodona le Europa.
text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Agbalẽnyanya xoxoto kekeake la, Sanskirt -gbe me woŋlɔe le. Le Upanishad nuŋɔŋlɔwo ƒe ƒuƒoƒu megbe la, Sanskirt- gbe ɖeko wòbu vĩi ɖe dziɖulawo ƒe ŋusẽkpɔkpɔ ta.
text_en: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Sanskirt nye gbe sesẽ aɖe si de to, eye eva zu egbe India gbewo ƒe dzɔtsoƒe, abe ale si Latin nye Europagbewo abe Fransegbe kple Spaingbe ƒe dzɔtsoƒe ene.
text_en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Esi aʋa si wowɔ ɖe France ta wu enu la, Germany dze dzadzraɖo wɔm hena Britain ƒukpo xɔxɔ akpasesẽe.
text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Germany tsɔ bebeme ŋkɔ aɖe na aʋa si woho la be "Operation Sealion". Britain tɔwo ƒe Aʋakɔ la ƒe aʋawɔnu gãwo kple nuzazãwo bu le esime wodzo le Dunkirk, eya ta aʋakɔ la gbɔdzɔ vie.
text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Ke Royal Ƒudzisrafowo gasẽwu Germany Ƒudzisrafowo (“Kriegsmarine”) eye woate ŋu atsrɔ̃ tɔdziʋu ƒe habɔbɔ ɖe sia ɖe si wodɔ ɖo ɖe Eŋlisi-Tsimɔ la dzi be woawɔ aʋa kple wo.
text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Ke Royal Ƒudzisrafoawo ƒe tɔdziʋu ʋe aɖewo koe wotsɔ da ɖe mɔ siwo dzi aʋa ate ŋu adzɔ le elabena ƒudzisrafowo ƒe gbeɖelawo nɔ vɔvɔ̃m be Germanytɔwo woava ho aʋa ɖe yewo ŋu tso yame ahana be yewoanyrɔ̃.
text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Míadze egɔme kple nugɔmeɖeɖe kuɖe Italiatɔwo ƒe ɖoɖowo ŋu. Italy nye Germany kple Japan ƒe "yomevi ŋutsu" koŋ.
text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Eƒe aʋakɔ kple ƒudzisrafowo mesesẽ abe dukɔ siawo tɔ ene o, togbɔ be ɖeko wotu tɔdziʋu yeye ene hafi aʋa la dze egɔme.
text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Italy ƒe ŋkuwo nɔ Afrika dukɔwo ŋu koŋ. Hafi woate ŋu axɔ dukɔ mawo la, ele be mɔ̃ si akpe ɖe woƒe aʋakɔ ŋu ale be woate ŋu aho azɔ mɔ to Mediterranea Ƒu la dzi avadze Afrika dzi la nanɔ wo si.
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Ɖe esia ta la, ele na wo be woatsrɔ̃ Britaintɔwo ƒe asrafonɔƒewo kple woƒe tɔdziʋuwo le Egipte. Le wɔna siawo godo la, mele be Italytɔwo ƒe aʋawɔtɔdziʋuwo nagawɔ naneke o.
text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Fifia míale ŋku ɖe Japan ŋu. Japan nye ƒukpodukɔ, abe Britain ene.
text_en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Ƒugɔmeʋawɔʋuwo nye tɔʋu siwo zɔna le tsi gɔme, eye wonɔa afi ma ɣeyiɣi didi aɖe.
text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Wozã ƒugɔmeʋawɔʋuwo le Xexemeʋa I kple Xexemeʋa II me. Le ɣemaɣi me la, wozɔna blewuu eye woƒe tu dada ƒe didime nɔ kpuie ko.
text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Le aʋa la ƒe gɔmedzedze me la, wozɔ mɔ zi geɖe le ƒu la ta me, ke esi wovadze didiƒenudimɔwo wɔm eye wodze dɔ wɔm pɛpɛpɛ la, eva hiã na ƒugɔmeʋawɔʋuwo be woayi ɖe tsi gɔme ale be womagakpɔ wo o.
text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Woyɔ Germany-ƒugɔmeʋawɔʋuwo be U-Boats. Germanytɔwo dze aɖaŋu le woƒe ƒugɔmeʋawɔʋuwo kuku kple wozazã me.
text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Ɖe dzidzedze si wokpɔna le ƒugɔmeʋawɔʋuwo zazã me ta la, le aʋa la megbe la, womegaxɔe se be wogale Germanytɔwo si le agbɔsɔsɔ me o.
text_en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Ẽ! Fia Tutankhamun, si woyɔna be "Fia Tut" alo "Ŋutsuvi Fia" ɣeaɖewoɣi la, nye blema Egipte-Fia si ame geɖewo nya le egbe ŋkekewo me.
text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Nukunutɔe la, womede dzesii be enye ame vevie le blema ɣeyiɣiwo me o eye womelé eƒe ŋkɔ ɖi ɖe blema fiawo dome le nuŋlɔɖi geɖewo me o.
text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Ke esi wovake ɖe eƒe yɔdo ŋu le 1922 me la, eva zu ameŋkuta. Le esime woda adzo blema yɔdo geɖewo la, womeka asi esia ŋu tututu o.
text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Wodzra nu geɖe siwo wozã hetsɔ ɖi Tutankhamun la ɖi dedie, esia lɔ asinudɔwɔwɔ akpe akpe siwo wowɔ kple gawo kple kpe siwo mebɔ o ɖe eme.
text_en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Afɔti siwo ƒe afɔtimegawo tso ga wo nɔewo me ƒe vava na be Asiriatɔwo ƒe tasiaɖamwo nɔ wodzoe, woƒua du kaba eye woganɔa klalo be yewoaƒu du adze le asrafowo kple tasiaɖam bubuwo ŋu.
text_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Aŋutrɔ siwo dona tso woƒe da siwo ate ŋu awu ame me la ate ŋu age ɖe futɔ-srafowo ƒe aʋawɔnuwo me. Le abe ƒe 1000 D.M.Ŋ. la, Asiriatɔwo ɖe woƒe sɔdzisrafo gbãtɔwo ɖe go.
text_en: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Sɔdzisrafowo nye aʋakɔ siwo wɔa aʋa le sɔ ƒe dzime. Womewɔ sɔkpawo haɖe o, eya ta Asiria-sɔdzisrafowo wɔ aʋa le woƒe sɔwo ƒe dzime ƒuƒlui.
text_en: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Míedze si Hela dunyahelawo, dzɔdzɔmeŋutinunyalawo kpakple woƒe aɖaŋudɔwɔla geɖewo. Ɖewomahĩ ame si amewo nya koŋ le dukɔ sia mee nye Homer, ŋkuagba hakpala si ŋu wotu xo le, ame si kpa Hela ha eve deŋgɔwo: Iliad kple Odyssey.
text_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sophocles kple Aristophanes woganye fefeŋlɔla nyanyɛwo eye wobu woƒe fefewo be wole xexemegbalẽ deŋgɔwo dome.
text_en: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Helatɔ nyanyɛ bubue nye Pythagoras, akɔntanyala si wonya koŋ ɖe eƒe nufiafia xɔŋkɔ si ku ɖe kadodo si le triangle siwo ƒe ememe dzogoe ɖeka aɖe dzɔ tututu la, ƒe axadziwo dome.
text_en: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Akɔnta siwo wobu tso ame siwo dona Hindi ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ la to vovo tso wo nɔewo gbɔ. Wobui be le gbegbɔgblɔ siwo amewo dona le xexea me dome la, ele gbe evelia kple enelia dome.
text_en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Dukɔa me tɔ siwo dona gbe la trɔna, eye esia kuɖe gbetagbe siwo tia ka kple gbegbɔgblɔ la ƒe xexlẽ ŋu alo woƒe maxlẽmaxlẽ ŋu.
text_en: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Akɔntabubu ɖee fia be gbeadolawo nye ame miliɔn 340 va se ɖe miliɔn 500 eye ame xexlẽme miliɔn 800 se gbea.
text_en: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Hindi kple Urdu ƒe nyagbewo sɔ, ke woto vovo le ŋɔŋlɔ me; le gbe sia gbe nuƒowo me, gbegbɔgblɔ eveawo dolawo woate ŋu ase wo nɔewo gɔme
text_en: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Le abe ƒe alafa 15 lia me la, Estonia ƒe dziehe kpa dzi nɔ Germany ƒe kpɔkplɔ te alegbegbe.
text_en: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Germany saɖagatɔ aɖewo di be yewoahe Mawu vɛ ale be wòate ɖe dukɔametɔwo gbɔ, eya ta wohe Estoniagbe si ƒe gɔmeɖeɖe le tẽ ɖe ale si wogblɔnae nui la vɛ.
text_en: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Wotu gbe la ɖe Germany ŋɔŋlɔdzesiwo dzi eye wogatsɔ ŋɔŋlɔdzesi ɖeka, "Õ/ õ" tsɔ kpe ɖe eŋu.
text_en: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Esi ɣeyiɣiwo vanɔ yiyim la, nya geɖe siwo woɖe tso Germanygbe me la va ƒoƒu zu ɖeka. Esia nye numekɔkɔ ƒe gɔmedzedze.
text_en: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Tso blema ke la, ame si anyi fiazikpuia dome la ayi ɖe asrafowo ƒe hehexɔƒe nenye be ewu suku nu.
text_en: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Ke Charles ya yi ɖe Trinity College Cambridge, afi si wòsrɔ̃ nu tso Amedzɔtsoƒeŋutinunya kple Tomenukuku ŋu, eye wògasrɔ̃ nu tso Ŋutinya ŋu, hexɔ dzesi 2.2 (ɖoƒe evelia mlɔetɔ ƒe ɖaseɖigbalẽ)
text_en: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Charles nye ame gbãtɔ le Britain Fia Ƒome la me si wona univɛsiti ɖaseɖigbalẽ.
text_en: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Turkey ƒe akpa si le Europa (Ɣedzeƒe Thrace alo Rumelia le Balkan ƒudomekpo la) la lɔ dukɔ la ƒe akpa etɔ̃ ɖe alafa dzi ɖe eme.
text_en: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Turkey-nyigba la ƒe didime wu kilometa 1,600 (agbadroƒe 1,000) eye eƒe kekeme wu km 800 (agbadroƒe 500), eye ede dzogoe ene me nɔ ge.
text_en: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Turkey ƒe ŋkume ƒe kekeme, si lɔ tawo ɖe eme la ƒe lolome nye kilometa kpeɖo 783,562 (agbadroƒe kpeɖo 300,948), esia ƒe akpa aɖe nye kilometa kpeɖo 755,688 (agbadroƒe kpeɖo 291,773) le anyiehe-ɣetoɖoƒe Asia eye kilometa kpeɖo 23,764 (9,174 agbadroƒe kpeɖo) le Europa.
text_en: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Turkey ƒe ŋkume ƒe kekeme na be enye dukɔ 37 lia si lolo wu le dukɔwo dome eye eƒe lolome sɔ kloe kple lolome si le Metropolitan France kple United Kingdom si nenye be wotsɔ wo ƒoƒu ɖekae.
text_en: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Atsiaƒuwo ƒoxlã Turkey le go etɔ̃ dzi: Aegea Ƒu la le ɣetoɖoƒe, Ƒu Yibɔ la le anyiehe me eye Mediterranea Ƒu la le dziehe me.
text_en: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Blema ŋutinya didi aɖe le Luxembourg si, ke exɔ ɖokuisinɔnɔ tso ƒe 1839 me.
text_en: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Egbe egbe Belgium ƒe akpa aɖewo nɔ Luxembourg me va yi, ke wova zu Belgium dukɔ ƒe akpa aɖe le ƒe 1830 ƒe Belgium Tɔtrɔkpatawo ƒe Ʋiʋli megbe.
text_en: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Tso xoxoxo la, Luxembourg dze agbagba be yemade dukɔ aɖeke dzi o, ke Germany tɔwo vanɔ eme le Xexeameʋa I kple Xexeameʋa II siaa me.
text_en: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Le ƒe 1957 me la, Luxembourg nɔ dukɔ siwo nye habɔbɔ si woyɔna egbe be, Europa Dukɔwo ƒe Dekawɔha la ƒe gɔmeɖola gbãtɔwo dome.
text_en: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Drukgyai Dzong nye mɔ́ sesẽ aɖe si gba eye wòganye Buddhatɔwo ƒe saɖagaƒeme le Paro Nuto ƒe dziehe go dzi (le Phondey Kɔƒeme).
text_en: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Wogblɔ be, le ƒe 1649 me la, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel ɖo mɔ́ sesẽ la ale be yeatsɔ aɖo ŋku yeƒe dziɖuɖu ɖe Tibetan-Mongol-srafowo dzi dzi.
text_en: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Le ƒe 1951 me la, dzo aɖe bi, si na be Drukgyal Dzong ƒe nu vevi aɖewo koe susɔ, abe Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal ƒe nɔnɔmetata.
text_en: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Le dzobibi la megbe la, mɔ́ sesẽ la ganɔ dedie, si na be wògali hezu Bhutan ƒe tsaɖiƒe nyui siwo amewo dina be yewoayi la dometɔ ɖeka.
text_en: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Le ƒe alafa 18 lia me la, Cambodia vamia ɖe ŋusẽdukɔ siwo te ɖe eŋu, siwo nye Thailand kple Vietnam la ƒe titina.
text_en: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Thailandtɔwo dze Cambodia dzi zi geɖe le ƒe alafa 18 lia me kple le ƒe 1772 me hetsrɔ̃ Phnom Phen.
text_en: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Le ƒe alafa 18 lia ƒe ƒe susuewo me la, Vietnamtɔwo hã dze Cambodia dzi.
text_en: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Venezuelatɔwo ƒe mama wuienyi ɖe alafa dzi mekpɔ dɔ o, eye ame akpa gãtɔ siwo le dɔwɔm la le ɖokuisi dɔwo wɔm.
text_en: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Venezuela tɔwo ƒe mama eve ɖe etɔ̃ dzi wɔna dɔ le subɔsubɔnadɔwɔƒewo, eye ame abe mama ɖeka ɖe ene dzi la wɔa dɔ le afi si wowɔa nuwo le, eye mama ɖeka ɖe atɔ̃ dzi wɔa agble me dɔ.
text_en: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Dɔ ha ƒe akpa vevi aɖe si me Venezuelatɔwo wɔa dɔ le lae nue amikuku. Dukɔ la kpɔa ga ŋutɔ le etsɔtsɔ dzra na gbetadukɔwo me, togbɔ be ame mama ɖeka ɖe alafa dzi koe wɔa dɔ le amikudɔ me hã.
text_en: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Le dukɔ la ƒe ɖokuisinɔnɔ xɔxɔ teti me la, ale si wotsɔ tu Singapore Numiemie Bɔ la na be enɔ bɔbɔe be woagbugbɔ atrɔ Ƒukpo la be wòavazu Abɔ Dugã xɔdzo.
text_en: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Le 1981 me la, wotia Vanda Miss Joaquim, si dzɔ tso orchid me la be eyae nye dukɔ la ƒe seƒoƒo.
text_en: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Le Kele lɔƒo le ƒe sia ƒe me la, lã siwo ɖua gbe, siwo wu miliɔn 1.5 la zɔa mɔ tso dziehe togbewo dzi, tsona Mara-Tɔsisi la heyina ɖe anyiehe-nyigba lolo gbadzawo dzi ɖe tsidzadza ta.
text_en: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Eye wogagbugbɔ trɔna, hetona ɣedzeƒe hegatsoa Mara tɔsisi la, yina ɖe dziehe go me, le tsiawo ƒe keke vɔ megbe le Afɔfie lɔƒo me.
text_en: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Serenti Dukɔa ƒe Park, Ngorongo ƒe Nudzraɖoƒe Nuto me kple Maswa Lãwo ƒe Dzraɖoƒe le Tanzania kpakple Maasai Mara Dukɔa ƒe Nudzraɖoƒe le Kenya wole Serengeti Nutoa me.
text_en: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Kadodomɔnuwo hehe vɛ sɔsrɔ̃ hiã na aɖaŋu siwo li xoxo la kple dɔwɔnu siwo wozã le kadodo nufiafiawo me (nutata-ŋutinyagbɔgblɔ, asitɔtrɔ le gbeɖiɖi kple videowo ŋu, ŋutinya gbɔgblɔ, kple bubuawo).
text_en: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Amewo kple kɔmpuita ƒe kadodo ƒe ɖoɖo bia be nàgagbugbɔ dzro ale si nèsusu tso nyakakadɔwo ŋu agabu tame le mɔ vovovowo siwo mesɔ pɛpɛpɛ o la ŋu.
text_en: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Amewo kple kɔmpuita ƒe kadodo ƒe ɖoɖo bia be nu siwo dɔ aɖe lɔ ɖe eme la natia ka kple wo nɔewo eye gɔmesese neganɔ wo si abe nu ɖeka ene.
text_en: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Fotoɖemɔ siwo kpɔa nu le didiƒe ƒe gbagbaƒee nye be nu siwo nane kpɔkpɔ lɔ ɖe eme kple nukpɔhuhɔ̃e ƒe nu siwo anɔ anyi hafi woate ŋu akpɔ nu le didiƒe ƒe dzidzedze vovovowo la lolo wu nukpɔhuhɔ̃e siwo mekpɔna nu le didiƒe ʋĩi o.
text_en: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Esia megavanye kuxi fifia o elabe nukpɔhuhɔ̃ewɔlawo zãa mɔ deŋgɔwo le nukpɔhuhɔ̃ewɔwɔ me.
text_en: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Esia wɔe be nukpɔhuhɔ̃e siwo kpɔa nu le didiƒe ɖena foto siwo sɔ kple nɔnɔmetatahuhɔ̃e siwo te ŋu ɖena fotowo le didime aɖe tututu tɔ.
text_en: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Nukpɔhuhɔ̃e siwo kpɔa nu le didiƒe ƒe gbagbaƒe bubue nye be ale si gbegbe nukpɔhuhɔ̃e la teŋu kpɔa nui la ɖiɖina zi geɖe.
text_en: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Esia na be nukpɔhuhɔ̃e siwo kpɔa nu le didiƒe, siwo mexɔ asi o la zazã sesẽna nenye be teƒe aɖe mekɔ nyuie o eye akaɖi aɖeke mele mɔ̃ la hã me o.
text_en: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Kuxi bɔbɔ siwo le sinima dzi fefewo tɔtrɔ ɖe DVD-gbawo dzi dometɔ ɖekae nye nɔnɔmetatawo ƒe lalã ɖa le toawo ŋu.
text_en: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Wowɔ TV geɖewo ale be woadze amehawo ŋu.
text_en: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Le susu sia ta la, nu sia nu si àkpɔ le TV dzi la, wolã eƒe liƒowo, le dzi me, anyi me, kple eƒe akpawo dzi.
text_en: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Wowɔna esia ale be nɔnɔmetata la naxɔ teƒe si wòle dzedzem le la katã dzi. Woyɔna esia be nɔnɔmetata lalã le eƒe towo.
text_en: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Nublanuitɔe la, nenye be èwɔ DVD(nukpɔkpɔ si wodana ɖe agba dzi) la, wolã eƒe liƒowo hã, eye nenye be woŋlɔ nuwo ɖe video la ɖome la, womadze nyuie o.
text_en: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Tso ɣemaɣi kea, titinaɣeyiyi saɖagaxɔ xoxoawo ʋu mɔ ɖi na nuŋububu, ɖoa ŋku joust kametete nɔnɔmetatawo, aglotuƒewo kple Arthur ɣeyiɣi aʋawɔlawo.
text_en: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Ele bɔbɔe be woaɖo ŋku aʋa wɔnuwo ƒe gbeɖiɖi kple ʋeʋẽ, woase afɔziwo le mɔ dzi kloe kple vɔvɔ ƒe ʋeʋẽ si tso tomegaxɔ ƒe dowo me togbɔ be ƒe akpe ɖeka de megbe na gbegblẽ la hã.
text_en: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Gake ɖee míaƒe nuŋububua nye nyateƒea? Nukata wotsu xɔ kɔkɔwo gbã? Aleke wota wo eye aleke wotu woé?
text_en: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Le ɣeyiɣi la koŋkoŋ me la, Kirby Muxloe Mɔ̃ Sesẽ nye mɔ̃ sesẽ wu fiasã akuakua.
text_en: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.
