text_en: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Woawɔ gɔmedzedze kple nuwuwu ɖoɖoawo kpakple kpe fafe wɔna siwo ayi edzi le xɔ me la le Beijing.
text_en: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Sno dzi-fefe bubuwo woayi edzi le Taizicheng snofefewɔ nuto me le Zhangjiakou, si nye kilometa 220 (agbadroƒe 140) tso Beijing.
text_en: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Woɖua Ƒe me zã le woƒe gbedoxɔ geɖewo me tso Adeɛmekpɔxe ƒe nuwuwu va se ɖe Dame ƒe titina, eye ɣeyiɣiawo trɔna kuɖe gbedoxɔ ɖe sia ɖe ƒe ƒe-me ɣletigbalẽ ŋu.
text_en: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Azã geɖe siwo woɖuna le gbedoxɔawo me la nye azã siwo woɖuna nenye be wole gbedoxɔa ƒe tutu ƒe ŋkuɖodzizã ɖum alo wole gbedoxɔa ƒe mawu ƒe azã ɖum alo wole azã gã aɖe si ku ɖe gbedoxɔ la ŋu la ɖum.
text_en: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Kerala ƒe gbedoxɔ zãwo nya kpɔna ŋutɔ, zi geɖe la, àkpɔ atiglinyi siwo woɖo atsyɔ̃ na, gbedoxɔ hadzihabɔbɔ kple azã bubuwo.
text_en: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Xexeame ƒe Azã (si woyɔna edzi edzi be Xexeame ƒe Ɖeɖefiawɔwɔ) nye gbetadukɔ vovovowo ƒe aza gã aɖe si kuna ɖe aɖaŋu kple dzɔdzɔmeŋutinuwo ŋu.
text_en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Dukɔ siwo kpɔa gome le eme la doa woƒe dukɔmewuwo hewɔa aɖaŋu kple nusɔsrɔ̃ ɖeɖefiawo hetsɔ ɖena xexeme nudzɔdzɔwo alo woƒe dukɔ ƒe kɔnyinyi kple blema ŋutinya fiana.
text_en: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Gbetadukɔvovovowo ƒe Azã si kuna ɖe Abɔgbledede ƒe Ɖeɖefiawɔwɔwo nye wɔna tɔxɛ siwo ɖena seƒoƒowo, ablɔwo kpakple nu sia nu ƒomevi si ku ɖe nu memiewo ŋu la fia.
text_en: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Togbɔ be woŋlɔe ɖi be wo yina edzi le ƒe sia ƒe me (zi ale si woawɔe le dukɔ vovovowo me) la, le nyateƒe me la, medzɔna nenema o.
text_en: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Zi geɖe la, wɔna siawo yina edzi le ɣleti etɔ̃ va se ɖe ɣleti ade me, eye wowɔna wo le anyigba siwo mele sue wu agbleka 50 o la dzi.
text_en: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Wozã film ƒe nɔnɔme geɖe le ƒe siwo va yi me. Esi wozãna koŋue nye milimeta 35 (didime 36 kple kekeme 24mm nɔnɔmetata yibɔ).
text_en: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Zi geɖe la, woate ŋu aɖo bubu eteƒe bɔbɔe nenye be evɔ, eye atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo si wòdena nu siwo wole ɖe edzi la sɔ kple egbegbe DSLR.
text_en: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Photoɖemɔ aɖe siwo le vedomesi la ƒe didime nye sentimeta 6, eye woƒe kekeme hã ganye sentimeta 6, si ƒe didime kple kekeme siaa nye milimeta 56 nɔnɔmetata yibɔ tututu.
text_en: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo si wòdena nu siwo woléna ɖe edzi la nyena milimeta 35 nɔnɔmetata yibɔ (milimeta togodo 3136 kple 864).
text_en: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Lã wɔadawo nye fotoɖelawo ƒe dɔ ƒe akpa sesẽ ɖeka, eye wo ŋuti dɔdɔwɔ hia na dzɔgbenyui, dzigbɔɖi, numetoto kpakple mɔ nyuiwo.
text_en: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Foto si woɖena lã wɔadawo la, amewo ɖeko wotsɔnɛ nu wodzoe ko, ke abe ale si fotoɖeɖe gbadza le la, foto ɖeka gblɔa nya akpe ɖeka.
text_en: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Lãwɔadawo ƒe foto lɔna nudidikpɔmɔ zazã ɖe eme, togbɔ be nu suewo abe xevi siwo le ya me alo lã vi aɖe hiã na nukpɔmɔ bubuwo zazã hã.
text_en: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Esesẽna hafi woakpɔ lã mabɔmabɔwo, eye ɣeaɖewo ɣi la, ɖoɖowo nɔa ablɔwo ŋu kuɖe fotoɖeɖe ŋu hena gadɔwɔnawo.
text_en: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Lã wɔadawo woakpe ŋu alo awɔ gbadagbada. Nutoa me ate ŋu afa, axɔ dzo alo manyo na ame ƒe anyinɔnɔ o.
text_en: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Gbegbɔgblɔ vovovowo le xexea me siwo wu 5,000, eye gbegbɔgblɔ siwo wu blaevee ame miliɔn 50 alo edzi vɔ dona.
text_en: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Zi geɖe la, enɔna bɔbɔe be woase nya siwo wo ŋlɔ ɖi gɔme wu nyagbɔgblɔwo. Adrɛswo koŋ yɔyɔ sesẽna.
text_en: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Le dukɔ geɖewo me la, ame sia ame doa Eŋlisigbe, eye le dukɔ geɖewo me la, àte ŋu akpɔ mɔ na mɔxenu aɖe le woƒe sidzedze me- vevietɔ le ame siwo metsi boo o la dome.
text_en: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Bu eŋu kpɔ be nèdo go ame aɖe tso Massachusetts, Boston, Jamaica kpakple Sydney wole kplɔ̃ ŋu hele fiẽ nu ɖum le nuɖuƒe aɖe le Toronto.
text_en: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Woanɔ dzidzɔ dom na wo nɔewo kple ŋutinyawo tso wo de duwo me, eye woƒe nuƒo ato vovo asɔ ɖe wo de duwo ƒe nuƒoƒo nu.
text_en: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Zi geɖe la, nuɖuɖu ƒeƒle le fiase gãwo me nyena mɔ nyuitɔ si dzi nàto aɖu nu le asi bɔbɔe dzi. Nenye be ame aɖe mate ŋu aɖa nu o la, ɖeko amea ava ƒle ɖaƒle.
text_en: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Fiase gãwo gatsɔ nu yeyewo kpe ɖe ɖaƒle ŋu eye esia le dzi dem ɖe edzi. Ame aɖewo gɔ hã gadaa mɔ̃ si naa dzoxɔxɔ nuɖuɖu ɖi alo gawɔa ɖoɖo ɖe mɔ bubu siwo dzi woato aɖo nuɖuɖu dzo dzi la ŋu.
text_en: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Le dukɔ aɖewo alo fiase aɖewo ƒomevi me la, nuɖuƒe aɖe si te ɖe afi si mɔzɔla la le ŋu nɔa anyi, eye zi geɖe la, enyena nuɖuƒe si ame sia ame ƒomevi ate ŋu ayi eye nuɖuɖuawo ƒe asi bɔbɔna.
text_en: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Wɔ wò gbetakpɔɖoɖo ƒe fotokɔpiwo eye nàlé wo ɖe asi kpe ɖe ame si de megbe nɛ ƒe katiatia dzesiwo ɖe asi.
text_en: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Ele be woaɖe megbedela na gbetakpɔɖoɖoa la ƒe email address kple eƒe gbetadukɔ ƒe yɔyɔdzesiwo afia hena nuxlɔ̃amewo/mɔɖeɖewo kple nu siwo nàdi be yeaŋlɔ agbalẽ abia la xɔxɔ.
text_en: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Fotokɔpi bubu nenɔ wò akpete me kple intanet dzi (dae ɖe wò email me alo nàgadzrae ɖo ɖe wò "cloud" dzi).
text_en: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Nenye be nèle mɔzɔm kple kɔmpiuta si wodana ɖe ata ta alo tablet la, lé emenuwo ɖe eƒe memory alo disc dzi (woate ŋu akpɔe intanet mazãmazãe).
text_en: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Gatsɔ agbetakpɔɖoɖo la ƒe agbalẽwo na xɔlɔ̃wo alo wò ƒometɔ siwo le aƒe me, siwo le klalo be yewoakpe ɖe ŋu wò la.
text_en: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Ƒeɖekadzoɖekɛ la mewɔa gbadagbada o, ke woaʋli wo ɖokuiwo ta nenye be edze na wo abe nane ɖe wòdi be yeate kame kple wo ene.
text_en: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Nenye be amewo mekpɔa ƒeɖekadzoɖekɛ be ate ŋu awɔ nu vevi yewo o la, woate ŋu ate ɖe eŋu akpa eye woade wo ɖokuiwo afɔku me.
text_en: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: No hamuamewo le ŋudzɔnɔnɔ me. Aha wɔa dɔ ɖe ame sia ame dzi vovovoe eye afi si wòle be nànoe se ɖa la nyanya le vevie ŋutɔ.
text_en: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Ahanono ƒe lãmegbegblẽ siwo ate ŋu anɔ anyi ɖaa la lɔ aklã ƒe gbegblẽ kple ame ƒe ŋku ƒe gbagba gɔ hã ɖe eme. Ale si wòate ŋu anɔ bɔbɔe be agblẽ nu le ame ŋu la gadzina ɖe edzi nenye be ame aɖe no aha si dzi se ɖo asi la.
text_en: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Nu makɔmakɔ gbegblẽwo abe methanol ate ŋu anɔ spiritwo me si ate ŋu ana be ame ƒe ŋku natsi alo ame naku nenye be wòno sue aɖe ko gɔ hã.
text_en: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Gaŋkuiwo ƒe asi dzi ate ŋu aɖiɖi kpɔtɔ le gbetadukɔ bubu me, vevietɔ dukɔ dahewo, afi siwo ame siwo wɔa dɔ ƒe fetu ɖiɖi le.
text_en: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: De ŋugble le ŋku dodokpɔ wɔwɔ ŋu le aƒe me, vevietɔ nenye be nèwɔ agbetakpɔ ɖoɖo ɖe eŋu, eye nàtsɔ atike siwo woŋlɔ na wò ɖe asi hena woxɔxɔ le teƒe bubu.
text_en: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Kuxi eve ate ŋu anɔ gaŋkui siwo ŋu woŋlɔ dɔwɔƒegãwo ƒe ŋkɔ ɖa ŋu; ɖewo manye gaŋkui mawo tututu o, eye esiwo nye gaŋkui mawo ŋutɔŋutɔ la axɔ asi wu aƒe me tɔwo.
text_en: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Kɔdi nye asitsanu bɔbɔtɔwo dometɔ ɖeka le xexea me, eye ɖewomahĩ ate ŋu akpɔ ɖe le wò dukɔ nuto me.
text_en: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Ke mɔnu vovovowo li le xexea me, si me wonoa kɔfi le, eye anyo ŋutɔ nenye be nèno wo kpɔ.
text_en: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Ʋe goglowo me yiyi nye ʋe, siwo ƒu alo esiwo me tsi le la gɔme yiyi.
text_en: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Ʋe goglowo gɔme yiyi lɔa tsiƒuƒu, nuwo lialia kple dzodzo ɖe eme- ke ehiã na ŋutilãmamla vi aɖe hafi woadze egɔ me (le kpɔɖeŋu me nenye be ètsɔe sɔ kple agakpe lialia, tsigɔme yiyi kple gbɔgbɔ mɔ̃ alo snodzifefewɔwɔ).
text_en: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Azɔlididi zɔzɔ nye nuwɔna si dzɔna le gota si lɔ zɔzɔ le nuto siwo me dzɔdzɔme nuwo le ɖe eme, zi geɖe le mɔdodo siwo wowɔ tɔxɛ hena azɔlizɔzɔ la dzi.
text_en: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Azɔlizɔzɔ le ŋkeke me lɔ zɔzɔ yi teƒe siwo mewu agbadroƒe ɖeka o va se ɖe teƒe didi siwo woate ŋu ade le ŋkeke ɖeka me ɖe eme.
text_en: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Hena azɔlizɔzɔ le ŋkeke me le mɔ kpokploe siwo wowɔ ɖi hena azɔlizɔzɔ dzi la, dzadzraɖo vi aɖe ko ame awɔ ɖi, eye ame sia ame si ƒe lãme sẽ vie ko la ate ŋu akpɔ gome le eme.
text_en: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Ate ŋu ahiã na ƒome siwo si ɖevi suewo le la be woawɔ dzadzraɖo vi aɖewo, ke vidzĩwo kple abɔdzokpo viwo gɔ hã ate ŋu azɔ le gota le ŋkeke me.
text_en: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Le xexeame godoo la, dɔwɔƒe siwo ƒo ta ɖe duƒuƒu le mɔzɔzɔ me la le 200 kloe. Wo dometɔ geɖe wɔa dɔ le wo ɖokuiwo si.
text_en: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Dɔwɔƒe si vaxɔ Xexeame Duƒuƒu le Mɔzɔzɔ me Dɔwɔƒea teƒe, si nye Go Xexeame Duƒuƒu le Mɔzɔzɔ me Dɔwɔƒe tiaa ka ame ƒe xexlẽme gã siwo kpena ɖe mɔzɔla siwo ƒua du ŋu le anyigbagã ene dzi.
text_en: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Eƒe kewo tso Barcelona ƒe Barcelona Duƒuƒu le Mɔzɔzɔ me Dɔwɔƒea kple Copenhagen ƒe Copenhagen Duƒuƒu le Mɔzɔzɔ me me, eye Czech ƒe Duƒuƒu le Mɔzɔzɔ me Dɔwɔƒea kple bubuawo kpe ɖe eŋu kpata.
text_en: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Nu geɖewo li siwo ŋu wòle be nàbu hafi azɔ mɔ ayi teƒe aɖe.
text_en: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Nenye be nèzɔ mɔ la, mègakpɔ mɔ na nuwo be woanɔ abe ale si wole le "aƒe" o. Nuwɔwɔwo, nuɖuɖu, ʋuwo ƒe flimenɔnɔ, anyimlɔƒe, nuwo ƒe anyinɔnɔ le mɔ dzɔdzɔetɔ nu, gbegbɔgblɔ kpakple nu geɖewo woato vovo le mɔ aɖe nu tso afi si nèle la gbɔ.
text_en: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Esia nye nane si wòle be nenɔ wò susu me ɣe sia ɣi, ale be nu makpɔmɔna aɖeke mado mo ɖa alo ale si afi ma tɔwo wɔa nui la mati kɔ na wò o.
text_en: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Mɔzɔzɔŋuti Dɔwɔƒewo li tso ƒe alafa wuiasiekeawo me ke. Katiatia kple ame aɖe si wɔa ɖoɖo ɖe mɔzɔlawo ŋu nyo hena mɔzɔzɔ si gade ŋgɔ wu nu si me mɔzɔla aɖe to va yi kuɖe dzɔdzɔme, kɔnyinyi, gbegbɔgblɔ alo dukɔ siwo me nɔnɔ mexɔ asi o la ŋu.
text_en: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Togbɔ be Mɔzɔzɔŋuti Dɔwɔƒewo lɔ̃a fãa be yewoakpe ɖe mɔzɔlawo ŋu le fexexe ɖe nu gbadza geɖewo ta do ŋgɔ na woƒe mɔzɔzɔ la, mɔzɔzɔŋuti dɔwɔla geɖewo wɔa dɔ kuɖe mɔzɔzɔ ƒomevi aɖewo ŋu, ga home aɖewo ŋu alo wɔa dɔ tso mɔzɔnya siwo kuɖe teƒe aɖewo ko ŋu.
text_en: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Anyo be nàzã mɔzɔzɔŋuti dɔwɔla si wɔa dɔ zi geɖe kuɖe mɔzɔzɔ si nègbɔna wɔwɔge la ƒe akpa dzi ŋu.
text_en: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Kpɔ mɔzɔzɔ ƒomevi si ŋu mɔzɔŋuti dɔwɔla la le nuƒom tsoe, eɖanye website dzi loo alo le fiase aɖe ƒe fesre dzi.
text_en: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Nenye be nèdi be yeaɖi tsa gamagblẽmagblẽ boo o ɖe dzizizi ta, ɖe wò nɔnɔme alo kuxi aɖe ta la, mɔ aɖewo li si dzi àto awɔ ema.
text_en: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Kploe ko la, wole hatsotso eve me: To dɔwɔwɔ le mɔzɔzɔ la me alo àdze agbagba aɖiɖi nu siwo ŋu àgblẽ ga ɖo. Nuŋlɔɖi sia ku ɖe ŋuɖoɖo evelia ŋu.
text_en: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Nenye be ame aɖe di be yeaɖe asi le vovomenɔnɔ me, ɣeyiɣi kpakple nuwɔɣiwo nyanya tututu ŋu, ale be ga si yeazã la naɖiɖi alegbegbe la, ekema kpɔ ga suetɔ kekeake si wòle be nàlé ɖe asi hafi azɔ mɔ.
text_en: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Nuxlɔ̃amenya lae nye be mɔzɔlawo megafi fi, ada vo le ame bubu ŋu, atsa asi le mɔnu si mele se nu o, abia nu alo azã ame bubuwo ɖe madzɔmadzɔ dzi hena woawo ŋutɔ ƒe ƒodo ta o.
text_en: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Afi si wotsaa ame ŋu le la nye teƒe gbãtɔ si nàtɔ ɖa nenye be nèle ɖiɖim le yameʋu, tɔdziʋu alo ʋu bubu me.
text_en: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Le keteke aɖe siwo tsona liƒowo me la, wotsana ame ŋu nenye be ʋua le zɔzɔm eye ele be dzesidegbalẽvi nenɔ asi wò nenye be nèle keteke siawo dometɔ aɖe ɖom.
text_en: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Le zãzɔketeke siwo me àte ŋu adɔ alɔ̃ le gome la, ʋukula la ate ŋu axɔ miaƒe mɔzɔgbalẽvi ale be maɖe fu na mi nenye be miele alɔ̃ dɔm o.
text_en: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Ŋkɔŋɔŋlɔ nye nu bubu si wòle be nàwɔ le dukɔmenɔmɔɖegbalẽvi xɔxɔ ƒe nuwɔnawo me. Le dukɔ aɖe me la, ele be nàda ŋkɔ wò kple afi si nèle ɖe mɔzɔlawo ƒe ŋkɔ kpa dzi. Àwɔ ezia le dɔwɔƒe si kpɔa nya siawo dzi gbɔ.
text_en: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Esia ahiã be nàɖo biabia aɖewo ŋu le agbalẽ aɖe dzi le wò dukɔ me kpovitɔwo gbɔ alo dɔwɔƒe si kpɔa ame siwo gena ɖe dukɔ la me la ƒe ɔfisi.
text_en: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: Le dukɔ geɖewo siwo me se sia le la, woƒe amedzrodzeƒewoe woŋlɔa ŋkɔ le (kpɔ egbɔ be nèbia nu tso eŋu).
text_en: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: Le go aɖewo me la, ame siwo le modzakatsaɖiƒewo godo koe wòhiã na be woaŋlɔ ŋlɔ. Ke esia na be se la gɔme sesẽna, eya ta bia hafi ɣeyiɣi la naɖo.
text_en: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: Xɔtataŋutinunya lɔ xɔwo tata aɖaŋutɔe kple wo tutu ɖe eme. Teƒe aɖe ƒe xɔ siwo wotu le mɔ tɔxɛ aɖe nu ŋutɔ nyena mɔdzakatsaɖiƒe.
text_en: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Xɔ geɖewo dzeani nenye be nèkpɔ wo tso xɔ kɔkɔ aɖe ta me alo to fesre si wowɔ ɖi tɔxɛ ɖe wokpɔkpɔ ŋu me.
text_en: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: Xɔtataŋutinunya tiaa ka kple nuwo ƒe alɔdze bubuwo abe dugãme ƒe ɖoɖowɔwɔ, xɔtutuŋutinunya, atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo na nutatawo, atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo na xɔwo me kpakple anyigba ƒe ɖoɖo tata.
text_en: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Ke woƒe duwo kple kɔƒe geɖewo didi ŋutɔ, nenye be mèyi ɖe Albuquerque alo Santa Fe o la zãme mavivi na wò o.
text_en: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Ke wodzra aha le tsatsadaƒe geɖe siwo le afi sia, wo dometɔ geɖe wɔa dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ wɔna siwo wonaa ŋkɔ la (gbã la, gãtɔ siwo ƒo xlã Albuquerque alo Santa Fe tututu).
text_en: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Nɔ ŋudzɔ: du vi 'hanoƒewo le afi sia menye teƒe nyuiwo ɣesiaɣi na amedzro si metso dukɔa me o.
text_en: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Nu ɖekae nye be, kuxi ɖe dzesi aɖe le New Mexico ŋu, si ku ɖe ame ƒe nudede aha me hafi anɔ ʋukum ŋu, eye ʋukula siwo mu aha la ƒe susu geɖe nɔa ahadzraƒe vi siwo le dua me la ŋu.
text_en: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Nutata alo nuŋɔŋlɔ siwo ame aɖeke medi o la woyɔna be graffiti.
text_en: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Menye egbe nudzɔdzɔe wònye kura o, ke ate ŋu anye be ame geɖewo kpɔnɛ be enye sɔhewo ƒe dugbadza kple ame amewo ŋutɔ ƒe nunɔamesiwo dome gbegblẽ to aŋɔ si wowuna la sisi me.
text_en: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Ke le egbe ŋkekewo me la, graffiti-ɖaŋunutala nyadɔwo li, graffiti ƒe wɔnawo li eye gli aɖewo li si woɖe mɔ na koŋ be woaŋlɔ nu ɖe wodzi fãa. Eya ta le esia me la, graffiti nutatawo dzena abe aɖaŋunutatawo, menye nuwo amewo ta ɖe madzɔmadzɔ dzi o.
text_en: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: Bɔl si wodana si gatrɔna vana edala gbɔ la dada nye aɖaŋu bɔbɔ aɖe si tsaɖila geɖewo di be neɖo yewo si.
text_en: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: Nenye be nèdi be yeada bɔl si agagbugbɔ atrɔ age ɖe wò asi me la, kpɔ egbɔ be bɔl nyui si agagbugbɔ atrɔ la le asi wò.
text_en: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: Le nyateƒe me la, bɔl siwo le Australia la mate ŋu agagbugbɔ atrɔ va eƒola gbɔ o. Nu nyuitɔe nye be ame siwo dze eƒoƒo srɔ̃m la nagadae nenye be ya le ƒoƒom o.
text_en: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: Woɖaa Hangi Nuɖuɖu le do dzodzoe si woku ɖe anyigba me la.
text_en: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: Wotsɔna kpe xɔdzo si woɖe le dzobibi me la tsɔ dea dzoxɔxɔ doa me, alo le teƒe aɖewo la, dzoxɔxɔ si dona tso anyigba me la naa dzɔdzɔme dzoxɔxɔ do la ƒe nuto la me.
text_en: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: Wozãa hangi hetsɔ ɖaa dua me ƒe fiẽ nuɖuɖu meme.
text_en: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Dzɔdzɔme dzo ƒe hangi le teƒe geɖe le Rotorua, ke hangi bubuwo le Wellington kple teƒe bubuwo.
text_en: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: Keteke ƒe hatsotso evee le MetroRail si le Cape Town kple ego do: MetroPlus (si wogayɔna be Ha Gbãtɔ) kple Metro (Ha Etɔ̃lia).
text_en: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: Gbɔdzɔe le MetroPlus me wu eye amewo hã mesɔa gbɔ ɖe eme o, ke eƒe fe kɔ mo dzi vie, togbɔ be egaɖiɖi wu metro tikiti gbadzawo le Europa hã.
text_en: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Metro Plus kple Metro ƒe akpa siwo nɔa keteke eve dome la le keteke ɖe sia ɖe si; MetroPlus ƒe akpa mamlewo nɔa keteke siwo te ɖe Cape Town ŋu ƒe nuwuƒe.
text_en: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Agbatsɔtsɔ na ame bubuwo- Mègaɖe wò ŋkuwo ɖa le wò akpeteviwo ŋu o, vevietɔ nenye be nèle gbetadukɔwo ƒe liƒowo dzi tom va yi.
text_en: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: Ate ŋu adzɔ be àvazu atikevɔ̃ aɖe tsɔ la, le manyamanya me, eye esia ahe afɔku geɖe vɛ na wò.
text_en: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Esia lɔ tɔtɔ ɖe anyi ɖe eme, elabena woate ŋu azã avu siwo teŋu ʋẽna atikevɔ̃wo sena la.
text_en: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: Dukɔ aɖewo hena to vevie na ame siwo dze agɔ zi gbãtɔ gɔ hã; esia ate ŋu alɔ ame dede gaxɔ me wu ƒe 10 alo wu ema ɖe eme.
text_en: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: Woate ŋu afi akpete siwo woda ɖe anyi ko ŋku malémalé ɖe wo ŋui hã eye se tɔ siwo le ŋudzɔ na bɔmb dada ƒe ayemɔnuwo la hã ƒe ŋkuwo ate ŋu akli wo.
text_en: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: Ɖe ale si nèdoa go kple dɔlékui siwo te ɖe ŋu wò edzi edzi le aƒe me ta la, woate ŋu agblɔ kɔtɛe be wò lãmekpoxɔnu siwo tea kame kple wo la kpɔa ŋusẽ ɖe wo dzi.
text_en: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Ke le xexea me ƒe akpa bubuwo afi si dɔlekuivɔ̃ɖi siwo tsona lãwo me nye nu yeye na wò le la, kuxiwo ate ŋu ado mo ɖa na wò.
text_en: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: Gakpe ɖe eŋu la, dɔlekuivɔ̃ɖiwo tsina kaba le nuto siwo me xɔdzo eye wonɔa anyi ɣeyiɣi didi aɖe le ŋutilã la godo.
text_en: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: Esia tae amewo léna Delhi Belly, Farao ɖe Fiƒode, Montezuma ƒe Hlɔ̃biabia kpakple woƒe xɔlɔ̃ geɖewo.
text_en: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Abe ale si gbɔgbɔŋuti kuxiwo le, le nuto siwo me fa la, dɔkaviŋutikuxiwo hã bɔ vie le nuto xɔdzowo me, eye zi geɖe la, enye nu si ɖia ame nu, ke mehea afɔku boo vɛ o.
text_en: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: Nenye be nèle mɔzɔm le dukɔ si mede yi ŋgɔ tututu o - alo le xexea me ƒe akpa yeye aɖe me la-mègabui be yemate ŋu ake ɖe kɔnyinyi aɖe si awɔ nuku na wò alegbegbe o.
text_en: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Dukɔ yeye si mede ŋgɔ tututu o la me nɔnɔ ate ŋu ate ɖe mɔzɔla geɖe siwo si ɖo mo vevie, siwo si ŋutete le la dzi, eye nenye be wote ŋu trɔ nɔnɔme aɖewo ale be woate ŋu axɔ dukɔa ƒe kɔnyinyi aɖewo de eme la, ekpena ɖe woŋu ŋutɔ.
text_en: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Vevietɔ le wò ŋkeke gbãtɔwo me la, de ŋugble le ga gbegblẽ ɖe amedzrodzeƒe, nuɖuɖu nyui kpakple kpekpeɖeŋudɔ siwo sɔ kple Ɣedzeƒe-nutome tɔwo tɔ la ene.
text_en: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: Mègamlɔ beli alo aba si metri o dzi anyi gba le nuto siwo me mèdze si woƒe lãwo le la o.
text_en: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: Nenye be nèle asaɖa tu ge ɖe xexe la, tsɔ asaɖa-bati alo aba si wotina ɖe yame ɖe ati eve dome la vɛ, ale be nànɔ dedie tso dawo, dziɖegbewo kpakple lã bubu si le abe wo ene la gbɔ.
text_en: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Ele be nàno kɔfi toto aɖe le wò aƒe me le ŋdi me kple chamomile ƒe tii le zã me.
text_en: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: Nenye be nèle mɔkeke ɖum le teƒe aɖe si te ɖe wò aƒe me gbɔ la, di ɣeyiɣi adi vivi ɖe ɖokuiwò ŋu eye nàgadi miniti sue aɖe hena tii tɔxɛ aɖe nono.
text_en: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Nenye be nèdi be nàgaɖɔnu bubuwo se la, wɔ mɔnukpɔkpɔ la ŋudɔ atu atikutsetse vovovowo ɖekae.
text_en: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: ɖewomahĩ àva ke ɖe nunono kpokploe aɖe si nàte ŋu awɔ abe ŋdi me nuɖuɖu ene nenye be nègbugbɔ trɔ yi wò gbe sia gbe 'gbenɔnɔ dzi.
text_en: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Nenye be nèle du gã aɖe si me wonoa nu vovovowo la, yi ɖe ahanoƒe siwo le nuto siwo me mèdena o.
text_en: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Nenye be mènya nya siwo wozãna le atikeŋutinusɔsrɔ̃ me o la, ekema ele be nànya be dɔlékuiwo ƒe dɔ nana kple dɔxɔleameŋu ƒe gɔmesese to vovo tso wo nɔewo gbɔ.
text_en: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Dɔ si dɔlékuiwo nana to vovo na esiwo nugbagbeviwo abe virus, bacterium, fungus alo lãvi bubuwo.
text_en: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Dɔxɔleameŋu nye dɔléle si kakana kaba nenye be ame aɖe te ɖe afi si ame si le dɔa lém le la le.
text_en: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Dziɖuɖu geɖewo dina be tsaɖila siwo le gegem ɖe yewo ƒe dukɔ me, alo yewo ƒe dukɔmevi siwo le dzodzom la nado dɔléle vovovowo ƒe abui.
text_en: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: Didi siawo ku ɖe dukɔ siwo me mɔzɔla la yi alo esiwo me wòdi b yeayi la.
text_en: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Nu veviwo dometɔ ɖeka si le Charlotte, Anyiehe Carolina ŋue nye be nu nyui adodoe vovovowo li na ƒomewo.
text_en: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: Ame siwo tsona teƒe bubuwo gblɔna be ale si wodoa vivi ɖe ƒomewo ŋue nye nu ɖeka si ta yewo yina afi ma, eye enɔa bɔbɔe na modzakatsaɖilawo be woakpɔ dzidzɔ le du gã la me kple ɖeviwo.
text_en: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: Le ƒe 20 si va yi me la, teƒe siwo li, siwo dea ɖeviwo dzi le Charlotte ƒe nuto gãtɔ me la dzi ɖe edzi alegbegbe.
text_en: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: Zi geɖe la, ƒomewo mezãa takziwo le Charlotte o, togbɔ be woate ŋu azã wo le nudzɔdzɔ aɖewo me hã.
text_en: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: Woagaxɔ ga akpe ɖe ga si wòle be woaxɔ nenye be ame siwo ɖo takzi aɖe wu ame 2, eya ta tiatia sia ahe gazazã vɛ wu ale si dze.
text_en: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: Antarctica nye teƒe fafatɔ kekeake le anyigba dzi eye wòƒo xlã anyigba ƒe mlɔenu si le anyiehe.
text_en: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: Tsaɖilawo ƒe sasrakpɔwo xɔ asi, ebia ŋutilã me lãmese hiãhiãwo. Ateŋu kpɔ eme vava le adeɛmekpɔxe-dzodze dzomeŋɔli eye Peninsula, Islands kple Ross Sea tɔwo koe ate ŋu kpɔ gome le eme.
text_en: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: Ame akpe eve nɔa afi sia le dzomeŋɔli le mɔnu geɖewo me tɔxɛ le nutomawo me. Ame ʋɛ aɖewo nɔa anyi le vuvɔŋɔli.
text_en: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: Antarctica nutomewo nye kponyigba ƒuƒu si ƒe axa abe kilometa 2 va seɖe 3 yɔ kple tsikpe.
text_en: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Ɣeaɖewoɣi mɔzɔla tɔxɛwo toa ƒu me yina to kɔkɔwo dzi alo kpo siwo ɖo gɔme gbadzaa la dzi.
text_en: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: Anyigbadzi ƒe Anyiehe Kpa Dzi kekeake ƒe Mɔdodo nye afɔmɔ kilometa 1600 tso McMurdo Ʋuɖoƒe le Ross 'Tsiaƒu la dzi va se ɖe anyigba la ƒe Anyiehe kpa la dzi.
text_en: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: Eƒe sno kplikplikpli siwo gbana eye wogaxea doa me hetsɔ aflaga dea dzesiwo la. Ʋu sesẽ tɔxe siwo tsɔa agba, sno-dzi 'gbatsɔmɔ̃ siwo me ami le, siwo tsɔ nuwo la koe ate ŋu azɔ edzi.
text_en: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Ʋuawo mezɔna kaba hele wodzoe o, eya ta ele be woava bi ato Totriɖenu siwo le Antarktika avado ɖe totame gbadza la dzi.
text_en: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: Nu bɔbɔ siwo hea afɔku vɛ le vuvɔŋɔli me woe nye mɔ siwo ɖiɖina, axadzimɔ siwo dzi amewo tona kpakple esi bɔ wu, si nye atrakpuiwo.
text_en: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Nèhiã afɔkpa siwo ƒe kɔwo nyo teti. Dzomeŋɔli fɔkpawo ɖiɖina le tsikpe kple sno dzi, vuvɔmeŋɔli-fɔkpakɔkɔ aɖewo hã menyo o.
text_en: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: Ele be nu si wotsɔ wɔ afɔkpae la me nagoglo nyuie, 5 mm (inch 1 ƒe mama ɖe 5 dzi) alo newu ema, eye wòabɔbɔ hena vuvɔ ƒe ɖoƒeawo.
text_en: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: Wogatsɔa nanewo kpena ɖe afɔkpa kɔkɔ aɖewo ŋu hena teƒe siwo ɖiɖina la zɔzɔ, ale be woalé afɔkpa-kpoawo ɖe te.
text_en: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: Mele be kɔ siwo le afɔkpa ɖome la nadidi o, eye ele be woanɔ gbadzaa. Zi geɖe la, wowua ke, kpekuwo alo dze (calcium chloride) ɖe mɔwo dzi ale be wo dzi toto nanɔ bɔbɔe.
text_en: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Sno ƒe ɖiɖi le agbɔsɔsɔ gã aɖe me le towo kple togbewo ŋu gboyaa menye numabɔmabɔ o, sno gbogbowo nɔa anyigba kɔkɔwo ŋu blewuu, eya ta esiwo sɔgbɔ fũu ɖeko woage gboyaa.
text_en: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: Kuxi lae nye be sno léna ɖe nu ŋu, eya ta ehiã na nudzɔdzɔ aɖe si ana be wòaɖe ɖa, eye nenye be sno aɖewo ɖiɖi la, mlɔetɔwo hã woate ŋu aɖiɖi ɖe anyi.
text_en: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: Ɣeaɖewo ɣi la, nu si koŋ ana be woaɖiɖi ɖe anyigbae nye ŋudɔ la ƒe bibi ɖe sno la dzi, ɣeaɖewo ɣi la, ate ŋu anye sno bubu ƒe dzadza, eye ɣeaɖewo ɣi la, ate ŋu anye dzɔdzɔme nuwo wɔwɔ, eye esi dzɔna zi geɖe tsona amegbetɔ gbɔ.
text_en: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Ahomyasesẽ ƒe dzɔƒe nye teƒe si ya si mesesẽ boo o la trona le, elɔa ya si ƒoxlãe la hegakɔnɛ ɖe dzi.
text_en: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: Wohea ya kɔkɔwo vɛ (zi geɖe agbadroƒe 100-200 le gaƒoƒo ɖeka me) eye woate ŋu atsɔ nu kpekpẽwo ɖe yame, atsɔ wo ɖe ya me le esime ahomyasesẽ la le zɔzɔm.
text_en: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: Wonyea fuɖe siwo dona tso ahom-lilikpo me, hevazuna "ahomyasesẽwo" nenye be woɖo anyigba.
text_en: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: Nu siwo wɔa AIK (Ameŋutɔ ƒe Intanet-dzi Katiatiaɣaɣla) bɔbɔe, siwo naa be ame bubuwo maganyaa nya siwo ame aɖe xɔna alo ɖona ɖa le intanet dzi o la nye mɔnu nyuitɔ si dzi wotona xea mɔ na dziɖuɖuwo ƒe asiɖoɖo nyadzɔdzɔ siwo dumeviwo xɔna la, eye wògaxea mɔ na ame vlo siwo adi be yewoate ŋu adze asitsanyatakakawo dzi le intanet dzi le madzɔmadzɔ dzi.
text_en: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: Wokpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe intanet-dzi nadzɔdzɔdila siwo wɔa dɔ ɖe wɔna bubuwo teƒe la dzi ɖe susu geɖewo ta: Wotaa mɔ bubu na intanet-dzi nyatakakawo, menye http ɖeɖe ko o.
text_en: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Intanet-dzi nyatakakawo zɔna kaba le wo dzi eye woƒe dɔwɔwɔ hã nyo wu. Woŋlɔna woƒe gbedeasiwo ɖe nya ɣaɣlawo me eya ta esẽna hafi wofina nuwo le wo dzi.
text_en: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Edzi edzi la, Nyadzɔdzɔdɔwɔƒewo daa alakpa le esia ƒe taɖodzinu ŋu, hegblɔna be eƒe taɖodzinue nye "mɔxexe ɖe fififi ŋu".
text_en: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: Le nyateƒe me la, nutome dzesiɣaɣlawo mewɔa dɔ aɖeke ɖe nuwo ɖeɖeɖa tso woƒe nɔƒe gbãtɔ yi teƒe bubu, si mele se nu dzi o; nenye be woɖe nu siwo wolé ɖe agba dzi vivivi hã la, woagate ŋu aƒoe le teƒe ɖe sia ɖe si woate ŋu aƒo gbãtɔ le la.
text_en: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: Taɖodzinu koŋ lae nye be ŋusẽ nagaɖo dɔwɔƒe siawo si ɖe woƒe asisiawo dzi ɖe edzi wu; gadzídzíɖedzi ƒe nyae wònye.
text_en: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Ɖe ale si kaƒoƒowo tona intanet dzi ta la, mahiã be nàgayi kaƒodɔwɔƒe si le afi si nèle alo afi si nèzɔ mɔ yi o.
text_en: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: Mehiã hã be nàxɔ nuto si me nèle la ƒe kaƒodzesi o; àte ŋu axɔ satelait ƒe intanet-dzi katiatia le Chicken, Alaska ƒe gbedadawo ƒo agatia kaƒodzesi si fia be nèle ŋudɔkutsu-Arizona la.
text_en: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Zi geɖe la, àhiã be nàƒle xexeame godoo ƒe kaƒodzesi vovoe si aɖe mɔ na KKƉD (Kaƒomɔ Katiatia Ɖoanyi na Duadza) kaƒomɔwo be woayɔ wò.
text_en: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: App nyui siwo ɖea nuŋlɔɖiwo gɔme ɖe gbegbɔgblɔ bubuwo me-wonye kaƒomɔdziɖoɖowɔɖi siwo wotu ɖi be woate ŋu aɖe nuŋlɔɖiwo ƒe akpa vovovowo katã tso gbegbɔgblɔ ɖeka me yi ɖe gbegbɔgblɔ bubu me.
text_en: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Kaƒomɔdziɖoɖowɔɖi siawo ƒomeviwo ate ŋu aɖe dzesiwo ƒe nuŋlɔɖiwo kple nu bubu siwo le xexea ŋutɔ me gɔme ɖe gbegbɔgblɔ bubuwo me nenye be kaƒomɔzãla do kaƒomɔa ɖe nu siawo gbɔ.
text_en: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Gbegbɔgblɔ gɔmeɖemɔ siawo ganyo ɖe edzi sãa wu tsã kpata, eye fifia la wonaa ɖɔɖɔɖo nyuiwo kloe (togbɔ be zi geɖe wonaa nyatakaka maɖinyawo hã), ke ele be ame nalé ŋku ɖe woŋu nyuie, elabena ɖewomahĩ wotɔ hã medzɔ o.
text_en: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Kaƒomɔgbegbɔgblɔ gɔmeɖemɔ xɔŋkɔ aɖe si le hatsotso sia mee nye Google Gbegɔmeɖemɔ̃, si naa be wote ŋu ɖea nya gɔme intanetdzi mayimayii nenye be wolé gbe la ƒe emenuwo ɖi vɔ.
text_en: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Xexeme Teƒenyanya Mɔnu (XTM) ƒe appwo ƒe anyinɔnɔ le wò kaƒomɔ deŋgɔ dzi nye mɔnu bɔbɔetɔ kekeake si dzi àto azɔ mɔ nenye be mèle wò de dukɔ me o.
text_en: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: Ate ŋu ana be ga si nàzã atsɔ aƒle XTM mɔfiagbalẽ alo XTM mɔ ɖeka aɖe alo esi nàzã atsɔ aɣee le kaaɣedɔwɔƒe la naganɔ asi wò.
text_en: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Nenye be intanet-dzi katiatia mele wò kaƒomɔ dzi o, alo mèle afi si katiatia la le o la, woƒe dɔwɔna nu aɖiɖi ŋutɔ alo womate ŋu awɔ dɔ kura o.
text_en: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Fiase ɖe sia ɖe si le dzogoe dzi la me yɔ taŋ kple dzesiŋlɔɖikaƒogbalẽvi siwo mele ɖoɖo nu o, siwo woate ŋu azã le fexeɖeanyi kaƒomɔwo alo telefon bɔbɔwo dzi.
text_en: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Le esime dzesiƒoɖikaƒogbalẽvi siawo nyo hena kaƒoƒo na ame le afi sia fi la, ɖewo ƒo ta ɖe kaƒoƒo na dukɔ aɖewo koŋ me.
text_en: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: Ame ate ŋu akpɔ gome le kpekpeɖeŋu siawo me to kaƒodzesi aɖe yɔyɔ kple kaƒomɔ geɖewo femaxee.
text_en: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Se siwo kplɔ gbe sia gbe fotoɖeɖe ke gakplɔna nɔnɔmetatazɔzɔ léleɖeanyi, alo se siwo gasẽ wu ema.
text_en: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Nenye be nèɖe nane si womeɖe mɔ na o ƒe foto la, mègabu kura be yealé eƒe nɔnɔmetata siwo le edzi yim la ɖi o.
text_en: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Nenye be nèle drone zãm la, wɔ numekuku do ŋgɔ ku ɖe nu si wòle be nàlé ɖi kple mɔɖeɖe siwo wòle be nàxɔ le se nu kple mɔɖegbalẽ siwo wòle be nàxɔ kpe ɖe eŋu la ŋu.
text_en: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Drone zazã le teƒe si te ɖe yameʋudzeƒe ŋu alo ame siwo xa ɖe anyi ƒe tame menye nu nyui o, nenye be se ɖe mɔ nɛ le wò nuto me hã.
text_en: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Le ŋkeke siawo me la, mebɔ be woaxe fe ɖe yameʋuɖoɖo ta to yameʋudɔwɔƒea la dzi le esime wometsa teƒe bubuwo hetsɔ asiawo sɔ kple wo nɔewo kpɔ o.
text_en: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: Ɣe aɖewo ɣi la, yameʋu ɖeka ma ƒe asi ato vovo le teƒe vovovo siwo woƒua ƒu yameʋuwo ƒe fe le gbɔ eye ehiã be ame natsɔ asi siwo ŋu wòke ɖo la asɔ kple wo nɔewo agakpɔ yameʋudɔwɔƒea ŋutɔ ƒe websait hafi axe fe ɖe mɔzɔzɔ la ta.
text_en: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Le esime mèhiã na visa nenye be nèle dukɔ aɖewo me yi ge hena tsaɖiɖi kpui abe modzakatsaɖila alo asitsala ene o la, afi ma yiyi abe sukuvi si tso gbetadukɔ aɖe me la hiã be nànɔ anyi wòadidi vie wu ame si yina tsa ɖi ƒe.
text_en: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: Zi geɖe la, gbetadukɔ me nɔnɔ le ɣeyiɣi didi aɖe me ahiã na wò be nàxɔ dukɔmenɔgbalẽvi do ŋgɔ.
text_en: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: Nu siwo wobiana na sukuviwo ƒe dukɔmenɔgbalẽvi xɔxɔ kple mɔnu siwo dzi wotona la toa vovo tso modzakatsaɖilawo alo asitsalawo tɔ gbɔ.
text_en: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Le dukɔ geɖewo me la, àhiã na xɔxɔɖesukume 'gbalẽ tso suku si nèdi be yeasrɔ̃ nu le gbɔ eye ele be nàgafia be ga le asi wò natsɔ akpɔ ɖokuiwò dzi le wò nusɔsrɔ̃ ƒe ƒe gbãtɔ me teti.
text_en: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Bia nugɔmekuku deto tso sukua kple dukɔ la ƒe dɔwɔƒe si kpɔna ame siwo vaa dukɔ la me ƒe nyawo siaa gbɔ.
text_en: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Ne mènye ame si le wò dukɔ teƒe le dukɔ bubu me o la, dɔwɔwɔ le gbetadukɔ me fia ko be ele be nàxe adzɔ ɖe ga si nèxɔna dzi le dukɔ si me nèle la me.
text_en: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: Ɖoɖo si wowɔna ɖe adzɔ si woxɔna ɖe ga si woxɔna la dzi ŋu toa vovo le dukɔ ɖe sia ɖe me, eye ho si amewo xena kple fetua ƒe hatsotso toa vovo gbadzaa le dukɔ ɖe sia ɖe me.
text_en: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Le dukɔ siwo me dziɖuɖu nɔa nutogã ɖe sia ɖe me abe Amerika Dukɔwo kple Canada la, woxɔa adzɔga le dziɖuɖugã la ƒe ɖoƒe kple nutogã ɖe sia ɖe me, eya ta adzɔga si woxena ƒe dzidzeme kple fetua ƒe hatsotso toa vovo le nutogã ɖe sia ɖe me.
text_en: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Le esime màto ame siwo tsaa dukɔ bubu me tɔ siwo gena ɖe du aɖe me ŋu gbɔ o eye nenye be èto wo gbɔ hã la, ɖeko woawɔe ɖe kpli ɖe ale be womada le se dzi o la, nenye be nèvaɖo wò de dukɔme la, ame siwo kpɔa nu siwo gena ɖe dukɔa me kple adzɔgawo xexe la gbɔ toto ate ŋu anye fuɖename.
text_en: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Kpɔ egbɔ be nènya nu si àte ŋu atsɔ vɛ kple nu si màte ŋu atsɔ vɛ o eye nàna woanya be yetsɔ nane si mele se nu o.
text_en: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: Mɔ bɔbɔetɔ si dzi àto adze nuŋlɔm tso modzakatsaɖiɖi ŋu abe asitsadɔ enee nye be nàɖe wò ŋutetewo afia le websait si dzi woŋlɔna modzakatsaɖiɖinuwo ɖa.
text_en: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Nenye be nènya ale si nàwɔ dɔ tso nuŋlɔɖiwo ƒe dzedzeme kple vodadawo ɖeɖeɖa le wo me le intanet dzi vɔ la, àte ŋu atu wò ŋutɔ ƒe websait.
text_en: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Gamanɔŋukpekpeɖeŋudɔ wɔwɔ le mɔzɔɣi nye mɔnu nyui aɖe si dzi àto ahe tɔtrɔ aɖe vɛ ke meku ɖe nunana ɖeɖe ko ŋu o.
text_en: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Gbetadukɔmenɔnɔ kple gamanɔŋukpekpeɖeŋudɔwɔwɔ nye mɔnu nyui aɖe si dzi àto adze si kɔnyinyi bubu aɖe, ado go ame yeyewo, asrɔ̃ nu tso ɖokuiwò ŋu, axɔ tamebubu tɔxe aɖe agasrɔ̃ aɖaŋu yeyewo.
text_en: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: Agate ŋu anye mɔnu nyui aɖe si dzi nàto awɔ ɖoɖo ɖe wò gazazã ŋu wòanɔ anyi ŋkeke didi aɖe ale be àgate ŋu anɔ teƒe ma wòadidi vie elabe gamanɔŋukpekpeɖeŋudɔ geɖewo naa xɔ kple gbe sia gbe nuɖuɖu hegaxea fetu sue aɖe na dɔwɔla la.
text_en: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Scandinavia Dziɖulawo zɔ Russia ƒe tsimɔwo dzi hevaɖo Ƒu Yibɔ la kple Caspian Ƒu la dzi. Woagate ŋu azɔ mɔ sia ƒe ɖewo dzi. Nya nenye be ehiã be nàxɔ mɔɖegbalẽ tɔxewo, siwo xɔxɔ asesẽ.
text_en: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: Ƒu Ɣi-Baltic Tsimɔ tiaa ka Arctic Ƒu gã la kple Baltic Ƒu la, to Ladoga Ta kple Saint Petersburg dzi, zi geɖe to tɔsisiwo kple tawo dzi.
text_en: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Lake Onega hã gatia ka kple Volga, eya ta ele bɔbɔe be woatso le Caspian Ƒu la dzi ato Russia.
text_en: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Kakaɖedzi nenɔ asi wò be nenye be nèɖo tsi dzi ko la, nu sia nu me akɔ na wò. Àdo go ame siwo tɔna tɔdziʋuwo hegana ɖe wo me le tsi dzi eye woagblɔ woƒe nyawo na wò.
text_en: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: Kploe ko la, àna nyanya amewo be yedi be yeakpe ɖe wo ŋu, àzɔ le tɔdziʋudzeƒewo, àzɔ ayi ame siwo le woƒe tɔdziʋuwo klɔm gbɔ, adze agbagba atia ka kple tɔdziʋukulawo le nuɖuƒe, kple bubuawo.
text_en: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Zã wò ŋutete katã adze agbagba aƒo nu kple ame geɖewo. Le ɣeyiɣi aɖe megbe la, ame sia ame adze si wò eye woana nyanya wò ku ɖe tɔdziʋu si le ame aɖe dim ŋu.
text_en: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Ele be nàtia Yameʋudɔwɔƒe, si le yameʋuwo ƒe habɔbɔ me, si dzi nètona hezɔa mɔ zi geɖe kple ŋuɖɔɖɔɖo.
text_en: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Togbɔ be àbui be yameʋudɔwɔƒe si dzi nètona hezɔa mɔ tiatia anye nu gbãtɔ si nàwɔ la, ele be nànya be mɔnukpɔkpɔ tɔxe siwo wonaa la toa vovo zi geɖe, eye woate ŋu ana mɔnukpɔkpɔ nyuiwo mɔzɔla siwo le mɔzɔm to yameʋudɔwɔƒe aɖe dzi wu dɔwɔƒe bubu siwo le yameʋudɔwɔhabɔbɔ la te, le teƒe siwo yameʋuwo tɔna ɖo la.
text_en: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Yameʋudɔwɔƒewo abe Emirates, Etihad Yameʋudɔwɔƒe kpakple Turkey Yameʋudɔwɔƒe keke woƒe dɔwɔwɔwo va Afrika kple katiatiawo va Afrika du gãwo me le fe siwo nyo wu Europa yameʋudɔwɔƒe bubuwo tɔ dzi.
text_en: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Edze be, le ƒe 2014 me la, Turkey Yameʋuwo dzea teƒe 39 le Afrika dukɔ 30 me.
text_en: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Nenye be ɣeyiɣi gale asi wò le mɔzɔzɔa me la, tsɔ wò mɔzɔfe yi Afrika sɔ kple wò dukɔ vovovowo me mɔzɔzɔ fe.
text_en: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: Mègaŋlɔ be atsɔ visawo, dzodzo ƒe adzɔgawo , anyigbadzimɔzɔzɔwo kple bubuawo ƒe fewo akpe ɖe teƒe siwo le Afrika godo ŋu o.
text_en: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Ne èdi be yeaɖo yameʋu atsa le xexea me godo ato anyigba la ƒe Anyiehe kpa dzi ɖeɖe ko la, yameʋu kple teƒe aɖewo ko nàte ŋu ayi elabena mɔ ɖeka aɖeke meto Ƒu gãwo dzi o.
text_en: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: Yameʋudɔwɔhabɔbɔ aɖeke mezɔa mɔ toa ƒu gã etɔ̃awo dzi le Anyigba la ƒe Anyiehe kpa dzi o (eye SkyTeam metona ƒu gã aɖeke ƒe liƒo dzi o).
text_en: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Star Yameʋudɔwɔhabɔbɔ yia teƒe ɖe sia ɖe negbe Anyiehe Pacific ƒe ɣedzeƒe kpa dzi tso Santiago de Chile va se ɖe Tahiti, si nye LATAM Xexemeɖeka Ɣameʋuɖoɖo ko.
text_en: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: Menye yameʋu sia ɖeka koe li ne medi azɔ̃ Pasifik ƒua ƒe anyiehe gome kple Anyiehe Amerika ɣetoɖoƒe ƒuta gome o.
text_en: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: Nagorno-Karabakh Armeniagbe dola siwo le Azerbaijan nutome ho aʋa ɖe Azeristɔwo ŋu le ƒe 1994 me.
text_en: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Woɖo dukɔ yeye aɖe anyi esi Armeniatɔwo gbɔ megbe. Gake dukɔ nɔ eɖokui aɖeke alo Armenia gɔ̃ hã mede dzesi o.
text_en: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Dukɔwo dome nyawo kuɖe nutoame ŋuti le mama dem Armenia kple Azerbaijan kadodo nyawo dome.
text_en: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: Canal District (Netherlandsgbe me: Grachtengordel) nye ƒe alafa 17 nuto xɔ ŋkɔ si ƒo xlã Binnenstad of Amsterdam.
text_en: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: UNESCO tia nutoame abe xexea ƒe teƒe si woakpɔ blemanuwo le ɖe asixɔxɔ tɔxɛ si le eƒe dekɔnu kple ŋutinya ŋu. Eƒe nunɔamesiwo xɔ ŋkɔ le dukɔa me.
text_en: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Cinq Terre si gɔme enye anyigba atɔ̃, nye Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza kple Monterosso ƒuta du sue atɔ̃wo habɔbɔ si le Liguria nutome le Italia.
text_en: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: Wobu du siawo de UNESCO ƒe xexeame ƒe domenyinuwo dome.
text_en: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Amewo tu toŋugblewo ɖe teƒe glidzaglidzawo, anyigba ƒe atsyɔ̃ɖoƒewo vaseɖe agakpe siwo te ɖe ƒua ŋu le ƒe alafa geɖe siwo va yi me.
text_en: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Eƒe xaxawo dometɔ ɖeka enye dɔwɔƒe de ŋgɔ meli o. Woate ŋu wɔ du dome mɔzɔzɔ kple afɔmɔwo, ketekewo kpakple tɔdziʋuwo gake womate ŋu yi duame kple ʋuwo o.
text_en: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Fransegbe vovovo si wodona le Belgium kple Switzerland to vovo vie na esi wodona le France togbɔ be woɖia gbe ɖeka kloe.
text_en: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: Xexlẽdzesi siwo le Belgium kple Switzerland fransegbe me kpakple nyagbe aɖewo yɔyɔ to vovo vie na France fransegbe me tɔ.
text_en: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Gake Belgium kple Switzerland fransegbe dolawo katã srɔ France fransegbe le suku wɔe be woate ŋu se xexlẽdzesiwo gɔme le France fransegbe me.
text_en: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: Asi ʋuʋu nye xɔlɔ̃ dzesi si gɔme enye "gbedoname" le xexea ƒe akpa geɖewo.
text_en: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Gake egɔme nye "zɔ va" le Malaysia tɔxɛ le Malaysiatɔ siwo le kɔƒe nutowome gbɔ. Gɔmesese sia sɔ kple asi tsɔ mlɔ ŋutilã ŋu dzesi si wòwɔna le ɣetoɖoƒe duwo me.
text_en: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: Nenema ke Britain mɔzɔla si le Spain mate ŋu se hede nyuie asi ʋuʋu sime asi me dzea ŋgɔ amesi le asia ʋuʋu o. Dzesi sia gɔme anye trɔ gbɔ va nenye amesi le asia ʋuʋu ƒe asi me dze ŋgɔ amesi wole dzesia wɔm na.
text_en: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Auxiliary gbewo nye gbe wɔwɔ siwo woɖe ɖe go kple susu be woawɔ dzeɖoɖo bɔbɔe le amesiwo dzeɖoɖo nyawo sesẽ na la dome.
text_en: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Woto vovo na gbe si ame geɖe dona si nye gbe nɔ eɖokui si kpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe bubuwo dzi hezu dzeɖoɖo mɔnu le gbe bubu dolawo dome.
text_en: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Tsi dzesi aflu mɔzɔlawo abe ɖee tsi le dzogbe ɣeyiɣi sime xexeame xɔ dzo.
text_en: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Esia tea ŋu gblea nu le mɔzɔlawo ŋu ne wodo bleziblezi yome esime woanɔ woƒe ŋusẽ kple tsi si kpɔtɔ la zãm.
text_en: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Vɔvɔ wɔa ame sesẽ le zãme le dzogbe dzi. Ate ŋu lé lãmefafadɔ ne medo dzoxɔxɔme ƒe awu ɖeke o.
text_en: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Anɔ ŋudzɔ ɖe muwo ŋu ne edzi aɖi tsa le avetsu la me tɔxɛ le dzomeŋɔli.
text_en: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Ne ega ku ʋu ɖi tsa le avetsu xɔdzoa me hã la, muwo age ɖe ʋuame le aɖaba ƒoƒo sue aɖewo me ɣeyiɣi sime neʋu ʋua ƒe ʋɔtru henɔa ya xɔm.
text_en: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: Bird flu alo xedzodzo dɔ ate ŋu lé xeviwo kple lã siwo naa no wo viwo siãa.
text_en: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Wokpɔ dɔlélea le ame siwo mede akpe ɖeka o ŋu gake ewu ameaɖewo.
text_en: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Ame geɖe siwo wɔa dɔ le xenyiƒewo xɔ dɔlélea gake amesiwo hã lɔa xewo kpɔkpɔ ate ŋu xɔe.
text_en: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Atsiaƒumɔ siwo de nu anyigba me kple bali siwo dzi kponyigba kɔkɔwo nɔna sɔgbɔ le Norway.
text_en: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Woyɔa kponyigba siawo be "vidde" si gɔme enye teƒe gbadza si ati aɖeke mele o.
text_en: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: Woyɔawo edziedzi le Rogaland kple Agder be "hei" si gɔme enye bateƒe si ati aɖeke mele o.
text_en: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: Tsikpewo srana tso toa dzi. Esia wɔ ʋe siwo tsikpewo ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ tu na..
text_en: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: Tsikpegadowo ƒe gli kple xɔ ate ŋu mu eye woaɖi gbe sesiẽ.
text_en: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: Tsikpe lolo siwo le nuwuwu dzigbe kekeake ate ŋu aŋe tso dzi ɖe anyigba.
text_en: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: Modzakaɖetsaɖiɣia le togbɛ nutowo me yiyi yia dzi zi geɖe le India le dzomeŋɔli.
text_en: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: Gake woƒe atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo kple nyonyo toa vovo le vuvɔŋɔli.Tsikpe dzadza ɖe togbɛ nutowome wɔe be amewo wɔa snodzifefe
text_en: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: Yameʋu dɔwɔƒe ʋee aɖewo koe ɖiɖia mɔzɔzɔ fe dzi kpɔtɔ na amesiwo yina kuteƒewo.
text_en: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: Yameʋu dɔwɔƒe siwo wɔa esiawo lɔ Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa kple WestJet yameʋudzeƒewo ɖe eme.
text_en: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: Ele be nayɔ yameʋudɔwɔƒea aƒle teƒe do ŋgɔ na mɔzɔzɔa
text_en: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
